name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Fight Back Against Hollywood's Agenda with Iggy and Mr. Kirk
body:
Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love.

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr57mqthos9d94jpnp0627u7dpfi76fu5rg9rlrg_rp22sh2s8i6epr7clgmcoj6cth2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztd8vkd5rdq5ml3cs950vb8vs3civav2btej0230_rp22sh2s8i6epr7clgmcoj6cth2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7libtbb7c9ffcug09lhp930u0ptdssurqkkb13g_rp22sh2s8i6epr7clgmcoj6cth2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpttg9spmqsl9s7tr3vs4o5r1oovtqavdgimorl0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7clgmcoj6cth2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk883kuv62pduj2j88krokvnriti1ldgu741v4o0_rp22sh2s8i6epr7clgmcoj6cth2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,
---
| | Kirk Cameron (and Iggy!)Actor, Author, and Father
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbheiik202e1qf6kt51psg3mjbps44tednk8b09o_rp22sh2s8i6epr7clgmcoj6cth2bs)
---

---
**Kirk Cameron (and Iggy!)** **Actor, Author, and Father**
---
|
---
| | P.S. The #1 thing you can do today to stop the Hollywood groomers who are tearing families apart – maybe even yours – is to support the very first children’s television show in _history_ made possible by contributions from grandparents and seniors like you. **[Please send in your Founding Supporter gift and help me reclaim America with the Biblical values our country was founded upon.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6opf0505bpg5vnl8dolknalmn88rbt7pvrb9h58_rp22sh2s8i6epr7clgmcoj6cth2bs)** Thank you and God bless you and your family! -- Kirk

body:
I have read the Bible enough to know that Jesus preached a message of love, peace, and caring for the poor, the weak, and the sick. The answer is: nobody.
| | | | | [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h15WC2PhGZWM2C7ol5R4irZWuY8HWVP2g_N_9qKWAABZhS3W6fxOmcsORWW0gTDm4dOoJcN_UnwzD9mI7yA9r-SC1QpK2PCckapEp4TCd6arHyvzMNFbdOWCJmmA9Rdl9MBChpNsMndABVuJTs1Fjc5kRjEBryiOdxl2Q8-hnO6R-y-eQ8WPxzrCoc1FAXRb_gLn6kNF9SlhyhJ7iGHG0ltoOxSL4qOF&c=kQONpRPhDE3nJZfHUDsQjQabfFxYrD8Xo1ShIGvM7Ji-lAGXNl387w==&ch=vZOLT5lNoShSd2yxC3EjZ58VO5rd9G4cxAMkKGKn74YAhepR_-8zqQ==)

Peter, It is a lesson America has learned too many times to repeat: politicians sending poor men and women to die in a war that helps no one but the arms dealer.
I am heartbroken by what I am seeing in the news. As a Christian, I know that my faith teaches me that all life is sacred. We are to pray for our enemies, not murder them and their children.
And what makes it worse is that the people pushing this war down Americans' throats are nine times out of ten claiming to be Christian. There were even reports of Generals telling troops this was a holy war waged as "part of God's plan":

---
| [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h15WC2PhGZWM2C7ol5R4irZWuY8HWVP2g_N_9qKWAABZhS3W6fxOmcsORWW0gTDm4dOoJcN_UnwzD9mI7yA9r-SC1QpK2PCckapEp4TCd6arHyvzMNFbdOWCJmmA9Rdl9MBChpNsMndABVuJTs1Fjc5kRjEBryiOdxl2Q8-hnO6R-y-eQ8WPxzrCoc1FAXRb_gLn6kNF9SmZCUp_jxSnXMmqC3MHCq4O&c=kQONpRPhDE3nJZfHUDsQjQabfFxYrD8Xo1ShIGvM7Ji-lAGXNl387w==&ch=vZOLT5lNoShSd2yxC3EjZ58VO5rd9G4cxAMkKGKn74YAhepR_-8zqQ==)
---

Now, I have read the Bible enough to know that Jesus preached a message of love, peace, and caring for the poor, the weak, and the sick.
So how can these politicians and pundits wear blinged-out diamond cross necklaces and AK-47 pins on their shirts, forsake diplomacy, resort to murder and violence, and then have the nerve to claim to be a Christian?
We are all shaped by our faith and worldview, and it seems obvious that the people pushing us into war worship money and power -- not Jesus.
I'm a Christian who respects everyone's right to exercise their own faith. That is what makes America such a beautiful place: religious freedom. But I see a lot of fake Christians right now in high places making some very evil choices.
When you are creating more cycles of endless war in the name of Jesus, we have a problem. Pete Hegseth, I'm talking to you.
Farmers don't start wars; they feed people. Farmers don't endorse billions in military spending while people go hungry.
[We need more farmers and fewer fake Christians in Washington to combat the greed-fueled policies hurting people here and abroad. Will you support my campaign for peace with a contribution of $10, $25, $50 or whatever you can do?](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h15WC2PhGZWM2C7ol5R4irZWuY8HWVP2g_N_9qKWAABZhS3W6fxOmcsORWW0gTDmIsHV2osPzfdTn-UisucqP2OznU2mWlAhsSO1VPXPMXvrq6Jvzs6Wqy1EtCgv5Yr7dG1h8_wUjhLBpKqtLfk01y-LWbPJlfGcVxuXmMy0ZyDq21iC_cYexJyI3RBa8c5oqNsqOEsuYGDH8Rlxo2d2aFIuP09F5b2n-sxoJJvrqto=&c=kQONpRPhDE3nJZfHUDsQjQabfFxYrD8Xo1ShIGvM7Ji-lAGXNl387w==&ch=vZOLT5lNoShSd2yxC3EjZ58VO5rd9G4cxAMkKGKn74YAhepR_-8zqQ==)

subject: A Letter to West Virginia Voters - From the Wife of Senator Tom Willis
body:
| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/1b09514d4516/a-letter-to-west-virginia-voters-from-the-wife-of-senator-tom-willis?e=a0285cc040)
---
|

| | | | |
---
|
---
| |

**Dear Fellow West Virginians,** Have you heard the true story about Tom Willis? My name is Sara Willis, and I’m writing to you not as part of a campaign—but as a wife who has had a front-row seat to the life, character, and calling of the man now running for the United States Senate. You may know Tom as a U.S. Senate candidate, a current State Senator, a business owner, or a Green Beret. But I want you to know the man I know. First, I’ll tell you something lighter—Tom has a great sense of humor. He’s famous in our house for his “dad jokes,” most of which are so bad our oldest daughter can’t help but laugh anyway. That’s part of who he is—steady, grounded, and never taking himself too seriously. But more importantly, **Tom is the most consistent person I’ve ever known**. He is the same man in public as he is at home. And he never quits. Our family has walked through hardships. We lost our son, Hunter, after a long and difficult battle with cancer. I watched Tom walk that road as a father—with strength, faith, and a quiet courage that never wavered. He faithfully led our family and held our son’s hand every step of the way. I had always known Tom was strong. He graduated from U.S. Army Special Forces training as a Distinguished Honor Graduate. He has led soldiers in some of the most dangerous places in the world.
But it was in those hardest moments at home that I saw just how deep his strength truly runs. **Tom doesn’t run from difficult fights—he leans into them.**
He has spent more than two decades serving our country in uniform, fighting terrorism and defending freedom. And in the State Senate, he has continued that same mission—standing firm for what is right, even when it’s not easy or popular.
Tom is a man of deep faith. He lives it out every day—not just in words, but in how he leads our family, how he treats others, and how he makes decisions. He is actively involved in our church and believes deeply that faith and service go hand in hand.
He is not perfect—but he is accountable. He surrounds himself with people who speak truth into his life, and he listens. That humility is part of what makes him a strong leader.
Tom cares deeply about the future of West Virginia. We have been so blessed to raise our family here, and like so many of you, we want our children—and future generations—to have the opportunity to stay, work, and build a life right here at home.
He is running for the United States Senate because he believes West Virginia deserves strong, principled leadership in Washington—leadership that will fight for our values, protect our freedoms, and put our state first.
I have seen his heart. I have seen him tested. And I can tell you with complete confidence:
**Tom will stand for what is right—no matter the cost.**
That is the same commitment he has shown to me and our family for over 15 years. And it is the same commitment he will bring to serving you.
That is why I am asking you to join me in supporting my husband, Tom Willis, in the upcoming Republican Primary.
Your vote, your support, and your prayers mean more than you know.
**Warm Regards,**
Sara Willis

## Supreme Court Tosses Louisiana Voting Map
The Supreme Court on Wednesday [struck down Louisiana's House map](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ_GdI6MMZAULq6hy7VXIsdew-aMF9lLIt7-xL3C34000qeZ789zfjpMmJffbgPLkeYM35qAGcq8QCnn5nKAUrkc_m-gbz4ixVkrPUhlZKfm4DCds2mCjQAaugZsO45jb7petc1qg1Ewuvt4DyYMRrfBPHzoXRzCa1Dw0A3ai6ZMp1qlTH-_GQ-m07H1UQ0vPbyEURCQqdzehJlXiOmkD5Sbp61JdmXeq-h-CT0JPeVzp8pXJfR0gYWelLnyQ-jpqPL6J_RUj73ABtLTUVgy1QpVJjqwostOrnRUkJvbJWa5uTcV-SHGvMiCy8pVOs8ygMeKlIWemmLD_sWUsA6jMGrZHKb_A_lHVj9W_wsAAP__BHmNZg) by a 6-3 vote, clearing a path for GOP redistricting gains across the South. Louisiana had been forced by a federal judge in 2024 to add a second majority-black district under the Voting Rights Act. The Trump administration challenged it as an [unconstitutional racial gerrymander](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2u4yAUxfHV4I4I8MUfBcU07jLtlBaGi80MhgiuE2X3o7y3hFf_pHOk_5_7ercxxbz_ticaCmXN-GoJibCuO9b6Pm32WBvVy_3z5ZWvUMKqhBq4AN6L1duY3it03gREhX2HRo7jqKHXQnaHEVuAYYYBvHYqTJOepJztLMGDlNMsu2g-awJ6IYUAPd3AIfQqSBfEsKlhYyDQRyr19rfETAeG9C5PrDdXzi6Zg-jRWP-LqYWphQ48YkofY2qpuF_JUiyZqcWVqxLfLFHCxtSiJw3jKHi7HhVP5N_-LBTzzmvcD2rcOmJq6arxj1dMKbZhZCD208avi45-1Oxp1P8AAAD__6JJgMY), and the Court on Wednesday agreed, despite the three liberal justices saying it would demolish the impact of the Voting Rights Act. The decision arrives during a redistricting war. Virginia's Supreme Court on Tuesday let stand [an order blocking certification](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAQhJ8GOqPFdoC_cPE3dLn2SuTYa7J3xkZmiZW3PyW6N7hyNNLom-_zulwtRUrrh93QcMhLwnpEZMayrFjKc7PJYzm4nO7b55rOkMMiQQ4CtFCweEvxuejWm4AoUbVo-nEcL1pdoG_vxgccFd4kDOM_O02TAqcGxBFBT4OzU0vmtQZaQQ-gL1OnHWolQ-8CDDc53BoN6Ilz6b4yJb5jiM_8wNK5vLXR3Jn3o1H_Gzk3cq61dpUf77KR8-tNI-eYnY3iNxT0dHAhx5RWUTBgweTPTURbj5NYnLu3jMLuhaKQk3jxtcX4vVKMdAxjo2HdLMU3Af9J28PInwAAAP__mUmDcw) of a Democrat-favored map approved by voters last week. And in Florida, Gov. Ron DeSantis [unveiled a new map](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSpCAURb9GMyzE12pCsIlZb7qhRcPDfjvIswCl---nen5h4lt165zz777eDQWK21-zoy6e14g1BywF07phSu_dRIcpl3TaL8c1np79qqQahQQxyNUZCu8VWqc9osKhRd1P03SD4Sb79qnVMDuHM4KcZwPjODuQoEBZnCZpRmxJf94kDLKXEm5zBxZhUL63Xo4PNT4akOiocOr-M8XyRB_efGHqLO9t0M9SjtwMfxq1NGqptXaeXx-Lz96o5eBAhWxu1JI4CofZxEJZnPFCCllErMIHTuSMsBy3hDkTRxPEbg5R-QxObHSh2PgQ-CrJCM9nEhlNyW3S7qgUAuVxakBuu6HwA1Z-VfPS6jsAAP__aEiNkg) Monday that could net Republicans four additional House seats.
## Fed Holds Rates Steady at Powell's Last Meeting
The Federal Reserve on Wednesday [held rates steady](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZEaNbWAIHFxCNpdeiIzdHvrW2CPTM2j-fsX-wmYlleqV9P7dl7ujRPnx1-1oOZYl43kkZMa6PLDWz-5ywHpwffmvUM78iiUuCtQgwUgNS3CUPotpgo2ICnWDthvHsTe6h67Z7OSM8UGP3k--G9DcAkTfx6kDXG9-VQ3ZiwZGQwdg-ltrPBqtYucjDKsaVmEAA3Gp7f9CmTeM6VPeWFtf9ibZjfl5CP1HqFmo-TzP1ufVX6VQ84UWagZz5UmoOWKQlBkrHiyrY5QBPR1UsnTPSklei3bjPTXVhudJKdExjMLAY3eUfj75V6LeVn0HAAD__0fGe-o) at 3.5%-3.75% in Chair Jerome Powell's final meeting, with four officials dissenting, the most since October 1992. Hours earlier, the Senate Banking Committee voted 13-11 to [advance Kevin Warsh's nomination](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuu2zAQRL9G6igsH5bkQkUadTdtSoGX3LUY82GQawn6-8BB_iDdFDODg_Pra_uyIYb8-GkTLkxly3i2iMxYtwfWeiWbPdbG9e2evpz5TYU2BWoUYISGzdsQr830fiFEhbrHRU7TdDP6BrLfF-NpJrhbnO2IdyIAnCcHd5DWK6nnPiyfNzAaJIC5zYNxaLQi6QjGbzV-dwbQBy51-F1C5h0pXuXAOriS-rjszK_W6R-dWju1Usg2Oxwuu5fyaXRqRVdySVenVls5uIidWhtmyyhcSSkw4ydlCjU18cQjZHHa2nbRkJt4vwS9YxT_JkdhFFSqyHgKQi_cbkMV0shRGq3NsHOKfV386wwxhjZOnYFHsiH-Beb_snws6k8AAAD__5eUlFs) as Powell's successor to the full Senate. Sen. Thom Tillis, R-N.C., [dropped his opposition](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OpCAUQJ9GO8wV8a-g2MZutt3SIFz07iAYYGTm7Tezr_D1Jycn589jfShy5Pff6kSZbVg9luQwZ4zrjjF-TuUNxpTjSz9NKP5lg1058IGBYB2sRpH7rKI20iJy7GqU7TiOveh6aOtDDqitaedJw6y3TU9ge5hgHvue49yKrib5tYHooAUQ_dQIjaLjttUWho0PWyUADeUQm7-BfD7Quk-4MTY6nLWTR85XqrpfFV8qvpRSGhve2yuRx5S-TMWXKzjKpFPFlyfe5FlRMR3sDDcmFjyylPFi2oWEkW2ow0l-Zx7fmVk0TB-KYh2luQo5R2kYKwH7qcj9b8g_GndL_i8AAP__GyKFbA) after the Justice Department closed its probe into Powell last Friday. Powell's chairmanship ends May 15, but it's unclear how long he'll stay on as a Fed governor. That term runs through January 2028.
## NASA Chief: Make Pluto a Planet Again
NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman [told a Senate panel](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLtu5CAUhp_G7s4IA_ZsCopt3GXbLa0zcDAn4WIBM5bffpVo3yD1f9Gn7-_79o4cOe9_MJHpvmyZzhapd6rbTrVeCbOj2np92k9Xzvz0xW9SyAWEBiU2hxyvTY_OeCJJaiQz3e_3WatZTGMwdpmtXpAeGidy6JUjcn6exNvbrAj1yObrTWglJiH0_OumLWkl_WS9WB5yeQxakONe6u2jcO6BfLzKi-rNljRGE3o_2qB-D3Id5Hqe560daOkrHeSKrdeSS7oGuR7x2csg14wNwQYmDx9YyQE3RJswQ8OrQaAGnvfQOe_gS4XvHTBgghfVC9LTBuAMPRBYTAcUDwk_6X8R4YiYqQPuyHmsxh0nx8htuQ9a7Ak5fqP3H_l-GfkvAAD__7CqmbY) Tuesday he wants to "make Pluto a planet again," and is preparing papers to revisit the dwarf planet ruling. The remark came at the end of a budget hearing, when Sen. Jerry Moran, R-Kan., asked about Pluto. Its discoverer, Clyde Tombaugh, was a [self-taught Kansas farm boy](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u5CAUxfGnsTssDPhjCorVrtzNKkWklNa1udg3wTACPBZvH01eIf3R70j_j_t8B3Lkt_9woM42zB6v5DBnjPOGMZYDvMGYcjzXLxMuf9pgZ8FFz7hiks8GyJVZ1UZbRIGyRt0Ow9Ap2fG23nXLlRxXlAt0it8UttDL8QYAwqIBHGrSL40ryVvOVTc2akUlhW1Xy_tF9EulOBrKITafgXze0boSnhibNRy103vOj1TJP5WYKjFd19UskTJ4Tyu8JpWYcjBQGHm2U8ohlkpMEy7xhFhYO7K_rhhk7-FY4Nx29o_S-vITe3NnDnXU5nGRc5T6oVJ8O4Dcz3f-VbCnFt8BAAD__9gPgfw). The International Astronomical Union [demoted Pluto in 2006](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2SpCAYQE-DGRYCih0QbGLWm25o0fKh7PBjwdda3H6q5wpzgPfq1fv3XJ_GB5_2vyaCRpfXBHcNgAhl3aGUFk2yUCqW9_Zl853eLruVMz5RJqlgqzU-tFV2VjsADqIDPSilRilGNnSHVptRm1WjFTN_wOwmCeNjFlIZYKNgrvP6Y2NSsIExOc693EAK7obNsenFpxeRDKzHXPr_2Sc8wIWWLyj9lmMX9IF4ViL-EL4Qvtz33Ye89Xu-CF_ggtKsaTS2ilA8VMIXU7HklGMjfPEI8UMdjfpKz_DGTFOmIacdCjX0DCYBEr50Rdvz9iH4Oiki2R6NDz8F-Kttl-bfAQAA__-HPYOP), ruling that planets must clear their orbits of other objects. Final say belongs to that body, not NASA. Tombaugh discovered the icy world in 1930 from [Lowell Observatory in Arizona](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1urDAQxfGnMR1oGJuPLVzchm5vmxKBPV6cDBjZZglvH22k5AXS_3SO9H-7j_fJs98e_6eVdHZh3OhMTDlTHB8U47VOm6WYcjzMhw3ndrjgRgRsS1ClhNFOnq9RFVY7IiRZkK67rmuUbKAuFt2Y3rrZTUbNtZtdf4MeXN-DAbihRFV4_VoDJaEGUE1fKUNKoquNg3bGdhYKyPocYvUe_JYXcnyFJ8XKhLVgveS8JyH_CRwEDhxOYq7IHgIH65N5SYFDJqZkwk6ppM_Fzz4ngcPORw7lD7vKXyVwKKK2--mZfWo7oeCxTp6_P_OfQj01fgUAAP__AFt_Yg), the only American to ever discover a planet--if it is one.

**Good Morning Angry Democrats!**
Something caught my attention today, and I don't think it's for the reason people would expect from me.
_Clip is from Pod Save America with_[Jon Favreau](https://open.substack.com/users/3728271-jon-favreau?utm_source=mentions) _interviewing DNC Chair Ken Martin_
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7ea9a01d-40ba-4ba2-932e-9a6825efea24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The DNC does not want to release the autopsy report from the 2024 election and I can understand why. If there are a bunch of different reasons why Democrats lost, putting all of that out publicly could muddy the waters, create a ton of noise, and turn into people who aren't even in the arena trying to diagnose what went wrong.
Even Ken Martin says there's no "smoking gun," that it was one of the closest elections in years, everything mattered, and that releasing the full report would just lead to people pointing fingers instead of focusing on what comes next.
And to be honest, I get it! But that's not why this is an issue.

* * *
## You Ran on It. So What Changed?
The problem is simple. If you're going to run on something, follow through on it.
Ken Martin didn't just casually mention releasing the report. He criticized the DNC for not releasing the 2016 autopsy and pointed to that as exactly what not to do. He said people deserved to know what happened and why Democrats lost. That was part of the pitch. That was part of why people were supposed to trust him in that position.
Then he gets the job, and **NOW** we're not releasing it.
That's what people are reacting to.
And this is where Jon Favreau is right to press him. He asked a very simple question: what changed between August and December? Why go through the entire process of doing the report, traveling to all 50 states, interviewing people, gathering all this information, if you're not going to show the full results of it?
And the answer keeps coming back to focusing on "lessons" instead of the full report, because the full report could be weaponized or distract from upcoming elections.
And again, I actually agree with that. But it still doesn't answer the question.
* * *
## Now Everyone Fills in the Blanks
[Share The Angry Democrat](https://substack.com/redirect/e68da68b-4b7b-49e8-abe2-80b228d4265c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Here's what actually happens when you don't release it.
You don't prevent speculation and conspiracy theories. You guarantee it. Everyone is going to fill in the blanks themselves.
Israel and Gaza is an obvious one. Internal divisions inside the Democratic Party is another. Messaging, candidates, turnout, strategy, all of it is now open to interpretation because there is no shared understanding of what actually happened. And instead of controlling that conversation, the DNC is now reacting to it.
So now you've created the exact situation you said you wanted to avoid.
And instead of talking about what went wrong and how to fix it, Ken Martin is spending his time defending why the report isn't being released in the first place.
Now that is the story and for no good reason... I think.
* * *
## Politics as Usual
This is the part where it starts to feel like politics as usual. That's what people are frustrated with.
The explanation turns into a lot of talking about staying focused, not looking backwards, learning lessons, and not bringing up the past (Like, why are you talking about that old thing again? That was 18 months ago. Move on!)

And again, to be honest that all sounds reasonable. But the way it comes across is different. It comes across like you're telling people not to worry about it, that they don't need to see it, that they should just trust the process. It's condescending. Patronizing.
Because people aren't asking for the report just to tear the party apart. They're asking for it because you **told** them you were going to release it. They invested time, energy, and money into that election, and they want to understand what actually happened. THEY WANT TO WIN!
And when you change your position after you get into power, it doesn't come across as strategic**, it comes across as dishonest at best.**
**And hiding the truth for people that really care at worst.**
* * *
## The Reality
[Share The Angry Democrat](https://substack.com/redirect/e68da68b-4b7b-49e8-abe2-80b228d4265c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
At the end of the day, I don't even know if releasing the full report is the best move. I think most Democrats would understand that dumping everything out at once could absolutely muddy the waters, create internal conflict, and give Republicans something to latch onto and attack with. There is probably a smarter way to release that information; by breaking it down into lessons and presenting it in a way that actually helps the party improve.
But that's not what happened here.
What happened is Martin ran on doing one thing, changed his position, and now is explaining why that change is actually better for everyone. And once that happens, everything else starts to sound like spin, smoke and mirrors, and fluff.
So, now it doesn't even matter what's in the report anymore.
People are going to make up their minds based on how you handled it.
#### So, what do you think?

clean_body: Why the DNC's reversal is fueling speculation instead of preventing it | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? We need to find other ANGRY DEMOCRATS. Please consider sharing and subscribing to fuel the ANGER for change. The DNC says the 2024 loss had many causes, but keeping the report private is shifting the narrative | | | Apr 30 | | | | | | | | | | | | Good Morning Angry Democrats! Something caught my attention today, and I don't think it's for the reason people would expect from me. Clip is from Pod Save America with interviewing DNC Chair Ken Martin The DNC does not want to release the autopsy report from the 2024 election and I can understand why. If there are a bunch of different reasons why Democrats lost, putting all of that out publicly could muddy the waters, create a ton of noise, and turn into people who aren't even in the arena trying to diagnose what went wrong. Even Ken Martin says there's no "smoking gun," that it was one of the closest elections in years, everything mattered, and that releasing the full report would just lead to people pointing fingers instead of focusing on what comes next. And to be honest, I get it! But that's not why this is an issue. You Ran on It. So What Changed? The problem is simple. If you're going to run on something, follow through on it. Ken Martin didn't just casually mention releasing the report. He criticized the DNC for not releasing the 2016 autopsy and pointed to that as exactly what not to do. He said people deserved to know what happened and why Democrats lost. That was part of the pitch. That was part of why people were supposed to trust him in that position. Then he gets the job, and NOW we're not releasing it. That's what people are reacting to. And this is where Jon Favreau is right to press him. He asked a very simple question: what changed between August and December? Why go through the entire process of doing the report, traveling to all 50 states, interviewing people, gathering all this information, if you're not going to show the full results of it? And the answer keeps coming back to focusing on "lessons" instead of the full report, because the full report could be weaponized or distract from upcoming elections. And again, I actually agree with that. But it still doesn't answer the question. Now Everyone Fills in the Blanks Here's what actually happens when you don't release it. You don't prevent speculation and conspiracy theories. You guarantee it. Everyone is going to fill in the blanks themselves. Israel and Gaza is an obvious one. Internal divisions inside the Democratic Party is another. Messaging, candidates, turnout, strategy, all of it is now open to interpretation because there is no shared understanding of what actually happened. And instead of controlling that conversation, the DNC is now reacting to it. So now you've created the exact situation you said you wanted to avoid. And instead of talking about what went wrong and how to fix it, Ken Martin is spending his time defending why the report isn't being released in the first place. Now that is the story and for no good reason... I think. Politics as Usual This is the part where it starts to feel like politics as usual. That's what people are frustrated with. The explanation turns into a lot of talking about staying focused, not looking backwards, learning lessons, and not bringing up the past (Like, why are you talking about that old thing again? That was 18 months ago. Move on!) And again, to be honest that all sounds reasonable. But the way it comes across is different. It comes across like you're telling people not to worry about it, that they don't need to see it, that they should just trust the process. It's condescending. Patronizing. Because people aren't asking for the report just to tear the party apart. They're asking for it because you told them you were going to release it. They invested time, energy, and money into that election, and they want to understand what actually happened. THEY WANT TO WIN! And when you change your position after you get into power, it doesn't come across as strategic, it comes across as dishonest at best. And hiding the truth for people that really care at worst. The Reality At the end of the day, I don't even know if releasing the full report is the best move. I think most Democrats would understand that dumping everything out at once could absolutely muddy the waters, create internal conflict, and give Republicans something to latch onto and attack with. There is probably a smarter way to release that information; by breaking it down into lessons and presenting it in a way that actually helps the party improve. But that's not what happened here. What happened is Martin ran on doing one thing, changed his position, and now is explaining why that change is actually better for everyone. And once that happens, everything else starts to sound like spin, smoke and mirrors, and fluff. So, now it doesn't even matter what's in the report anymore. People are going to make up their minds based on how you handled it. So, what do you think? Stay Angry Join otherANGRY DEMOCRATS** by support Matt's work. Peter,
Yesterday, the Supreme Court set America back 60 years.

| Dear Patriot,
A man handed a homeless person a post-it note and a dollar bill on a sidewalk in Los Angeles. On the note was a name, an address, and a date of birth — **a real voter's identity.** “Sign his name,” the man said. “Just write what I tell you to write.”**[**We filmed the whole thing.**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkbuOnTAQhp_GdCBfMPgULiIhuk2bEg32ANbii3zJvn7EWaVKlXL--eaXPs2vj-0D3O3C-RM86lyPLZetXvh1uYpXbAUzlhSDRVtj3DjlU0_HXtCHY53V1lhgpkPN5nmWo6RSdZemQgimDi4ZfUlKj5lZPioGMIndTAo6p58qOgrKqKByHNSslDQWJ3u8JHvtZKRwY65DxtT22xkIFcrnEbPBwUTf3fqqNRUifhC-Er4WNC3jAAFtrA9B-Bo_EQ_0aB2cObb0RP7sbcQSan9BShh6v_cpJiBibdVvJbZskIjlH5Dw6QGetuaJWN5H35kBn8CdgYjlW4urv5sYKoZKxJLrQfgEPrb3yGWXtU1f7r5dmWYy0tODu99q9f8f8VvzPwEAAP__ZNqZKg)

**[****](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkbuOnTAQhp_GdCBfMPgULiIhuk2bEg32ANbii3zJvn7EWaVKlXL--eaXPs2vj-0D3O3C-RM86lyPLZetXvh1uYpXbAUzlhSDRVtj3DjlU0_HXtCHY53V1lhgpkPN5nmWo6RSdZemQgimDi4ZfUlKj5lZPioGMIndTAo6p58qOgrKqKByHNSslDQWJ3u8JHvtZKRwY65DxtT22xkIFcrnEbPBwUTf3fqqNRUifhC-Er4WNC3jAAFtrA9B-Bo_EQ_0aB2cObb0RP7sbcQSan9BShh6v_cpJiBibdVvJbZskIjlH5Dw6QGetuaJWN5H35kBn8CdgYjlW4urv5sYKoZKxJLrQfgEPrb3yGWXtU1f7r5dmWYy0tODu99q9f8f8VvzPwEAAP__ZNqZKg)What you're about to see is the most explosive hidden-camera footage my team has ever captured. Not speculation. Not anonymous sources.**Actual election crimes committed on camera — in broad daylight — on the streets of Los Angeles.** Over the course of several days, my undercover journalists documented petition circulators handing post-it notes with real voters' names and addresses to homeless individuals, paying them cash — one to three dollars per signature — and instructing them to forge those voters' signatures on official petitions and voter registration forms.We captured it **twenty-eight times.** That's twenty-eight documented instances in just a few days of filming. Which means across Los Angeles County, this is happening **tens of thousands of times.**[****](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkbuOnTAQhp_GdCBfMPgULiIhuk2bEg32ANbii3zJvn7EWaVKlXL--eaXPs2vj-0D3O3C-RM86lyPLZetXvh1uYpXbAUzlhSDRVtj3DjlU0_HXtCHY53V1lhgpkPN5nmWo6RSdZemQgimDi4ZfUlKj5lZPioGMIndTAo6p58qOgrKqKByHNSslDQWJ3u8JHvtZKRwY65DxtT22xkIFcrnEbPBwUTf3fqqNRUifhC-Er4WNC3jAAFtrA9B-Bo_EQ_0aB2cObb0RP7sbcQSan9BShh6v_cpJiBibdVvJbZskIjlH5Dw6QGetuaJWN5H35kBn8CdgYjlW4urv5sYKoZKxJLrQfgEPrb3yGWXtU1f7r5dmWYy0tODu99q9f8f8VvzPwEAAP__ZNqZKg "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=rtf&amount=25")****| [▶ WATCH THE HIDDEN-CAMERA FOOTAGE AND CHIP IN $35](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkbuOnTAQhp_GdCBfMPgULiIhuk2bEg32ANbii3zJvn7EWaVKlXL--eaXPs2vj-0D3O3C-RM86lyPLZetXvh1uYpXbAUzlhSDRVtj3DjlU0_HXtCHY53V1lhgpkPN5nmWo6RSdZemQgimDi4ZfUlKj5lZPioGMIndTAo6p58qOgrKqKByHNSslDQWJ3u8JHvtZKRwY65DxtT22xkIFcrnEbPBwUTf3fqqNRUifhC-Er4WNC3jAAFtrA9B-Bo_EQ_0aB2cObb0RP7sbcQSan9BShh6v_cpJiBibdVvJbZskIjlH5Dw6QGetuaJWN5H35kBn8CdgYjlW4urv5sYKoZKxJLrQfgEPrb3yGWXtU1f7r5dmWYy0tODu99q9f8f8VvzPwEAAP__ZNqZKg "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-doesnt-happen-mb-popa?utm_source=omg-doesnt-happen&utm_medium=popa&utm_campaign=20260428&utm_content=rtf&amount=25")

Let me walk you through what our cameras caught.
A voter named Vicky Walker. A voter named Paulson. A voter named Joseph Albright. Real people. Real identities. In each case, a petition coordinator handed a homeless person a sticky note bearing that voter's information and told them to sign as if they were that person.
One coordinator was caught on camera admitting they get paid seven to ten dollars per signature. They're turning around and paying homeless people a fraction of that — a dollar, sometimes three — to commit federal crimes on their behalf.
Let me be clear about what we're talking about: **it is a federal crime to provide false information on a voter registration form. It is a federal crime to offer payment for voter registration.** What we documented is not a gray area. It is multiple felonies, exposed on hidden camera, happening systematically.
The New York Times told America this doesn't happen. Their Sunday edition dismissed election fraud concerns. **We just proved them wrong twenty-eight times on tape.**

## EF-3 Tornado Hits Mineral Wells
An EF-3 tornado hit Mineral Wells Tuesday evening, injuring five people, causing [widespread damage](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDtuwzAQRE8jdRT4k2kVLNKoc9qUwtpcWgRWokFuTPv2gYLcIN0Ugxm893VZLpAo7fdP2NDzK-Zlx1YJmbEsnMsOIa-J65Z2LEANiWosi5b6JKQVRi4BEr0X2wd_lWFSPXrlnButk6PpVx_UqG7SGqW0ilE5uKownaIBmM7ajLFP_hiT1kilpFV6sFMw2rmIarqqs7adlRgS5zLwiowvqJHe-YlluOWtJ78yP2pnPjo9d3purQ0xv-yBcRQ6PR-x03MAIqiiIfCKRVR8YkFROZdN8FoQWBTk77JXsUIi0dIexJ-CvvjwaIko1ZPrrLxvkOj3n_9n7en1TwAAAP__M52EBA), and displacing several families. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Re: competing against Sununu...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260430_1.nU954c&refcode=em20260430-1&t=1&akid=6390%2E582294%2EQQEL3m)
I know what it’s like to run against a Republican with high name ID and a national donor network behind him — I’ve done it before. And I won.
Now, Chris Pappas is facing the same kind of threat in New Hampshire. National Republicans managed to recruit former Senator John Sununu into the race — and the latest polling shows this race will be close.
Look, in order for Democrats to take back the Senate majority and put an end to Trump’s unchecked power, winning in New Hampshire is absolutely critical.
**[That’s why I’m in this fight with everything I’ve got. And why I’m asking you to please pitch in $5 right now to help Chris Pappas stand up to big-money Republicans, compete against John Sununu, and keep this seat blue.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260430_1.nU954c&refcode=em20260430-1&t=2&akid=6390%2E582294%2EQQEL3m)**
**[Donate $5 to support Chris Pappas »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260430_1.1CK8RJ&refcode=em20260430-1&t=3&akid=6390%2E582294%2EQQEL3m)**
Chris is a Granite Stater through and through. He’s not in this for power or prestige or to cozy up to billionaires. _He’s in it to make life better for working families — the folks who get up every day, work hard, and are struggling to get by._ He’s fought Big Pharma to lower prescription drug prices, stood up for veterans, and protected reproductive rights when they’ve been under relentless attack.
Chris Pappas fights for the people — not the wealthy and well-connected. He shows up, he listens, and he gets things done. That’s what New Hampshire needs, and it’s what working people across the country need.
**But Republicans know New Hampshire is one of their best shots at flipping a Senate seat this year.** Sununu has the name recognition, the right-wing billionaire network, and the full weight of the national GOP behind him.
We’ve seen this before. Special interests will flood races with corporate money and try to buy Senators who will work for them instead of their constituents. We can’t let this happen in New Hampshire.
**If you believe, like I do, that government ought to work for working people — not the rich and powerful —[then I’m asking you to please chip in to Chris’s campaign now to help him compete and win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260430_1.nU954c&refcode=em20260430-1&t=4&akid=6390%2E582294%2EQQEL3m)**
I know Chris has what it takes to win this race. But we all need to make sure he has the resources to fight back against this massive right-wing spending.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

Peter,
You know why I’m reaching out — it’s to humbly ask for your support in my reelection campaign here in Georgia.
But before I ask for your contribution, I think you deserve an explanation for why this race is so important, and why I’m asking for your support, particularly right now.
**I am MAGA’s #1 target in the midterms.**
Don’t forget, we’re talking about _Georgia_. The most competitive battleground state _in the country._
And something that folks aren’t paying enough attention to is that National Republicans have vastly more resources than National Democrats right now.
I expect the GOP and their Super PACs will spend _hundreds of millions of dollars_ against me.
So I’m asking you to take nothing for granted. This is something you can do _right now_ that will have a BIG impact: [**Make a donation to my reelection campaign today.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-april26.1MDdBw&refcode=em260430-1-subs&t=2&akid=2196%2E5691347%2EUkKC2o)
Peter, my campaign won't accept contributions from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists. That means the vast majority of the donations that fuel this campaign come from emails just like this one. People chipping in $10, $25, or $50 at a time.
And the money we raise _right now_ means we mobilize more voters in every corner of the state, place more ads to spread my message across Georgia, and hire more staff to sustain and even expand our efforts.
And while I certainly don't expect you or anyone else to donate to every email my team and I send, I hope you'll consider donating to this one today.

It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. clean_body: ...this may be our last chance to honor them| | | Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. - | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Peter, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade P.S. Peter, America is stepping into its 250th year, and this Memorial Day begins that national remembrance. Veterans across generations have given their lives to defend America and all she stands for. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. There's no better send-off we can give them than to make sure they're present to honor their fallen brethren during America's 250th birthday. | "Promise me you'll take care of my son."
Those were the last words Amber Nicole Thurman said to her own mother before being taken into surgery.
She should have lived.
Doctors say a routine procedure could have saved her--but they waited, fearing prosecution under Georgia's abortion ban. That delay cost Amber her life and left her son without a mother. This is not an isolated tragedy. It is the direct consequence of decisions made by the Georgia Supreme Court.

| Make no mistake, the stakes in Georgia's Supreme Court election are life and death. On May 19, Georgia voters will decide whether to keep justices who helped reinstate this devastating law--or begin to change the direction of the court.
Incumbent Justices Charlie Bethel and Sarah Warren were part of the majority that allowed this ban to take effect.
Last week, both justices were endorsed by Frontline Policy Action, a powerful anti-abortion group working to push even more extreme policies. The Southern Poverty Law Center describes FPA as "ultra conservative" and says its goals "largely involve changing public policy in Georgia to align with far-right anti-abortion and anti-LGBTQ ideologies."
At the same time, their pro-rights, pro-democracy challengers, Jen Jordan and Miracle Rankin, announced their endorsements by Planned Parenthood Votes and Reproductive Freedom For All.
This is the choice. And it could not be more stark.
Life or death. Freedom or control. Rights protected--or taken away. Defend Our Courts has already proven what's possible with back-to-back wins in the Pennsylvania and Wisconsin Supreme Court races.
Georgia is next, and it lays the foundation to flip Georgia's Supreme Court, but only if we act immediately. We are working to support a full-scale effort to reach voters across Georgia, but there is a critical funding gap that must be closed right now to keep this program fully operational.
If we don't step in, this opportunity could slip away.

clean_body: For countless Georgia women, the stakes on May 19th couldn’t be higher. | | | | If you believe you've received this email in error, you may unsubscribe below. | | | | | == | "Promise me you'll take care of my son." Those were the last words Amber Nicole Thurman said to her own mother before being taken into surgery. She should have lived. Doctors say a routine procedure could have saved her--but they waited, fearing prosecution under Georgia's abortion ban. That delay cost Amber her life and left her son without a mother. This is not an isolated tragedy. It is the direct consequence of decisions made by the Georgia Supreme Court. | == | Make no mistake, the stakes in Georgia's Supreme Court election are life and death. On May 19, Georgia voters will decide whether to keep justices who helped reinstate this devastating law--or begin to change the direction of the court. Incumbent Justices Charlie Bethel and Sarah Warren were part of the majority that allowed this ban to take effect. Last week, both justices were endorsed by Frontline Policy Action, a powerful anti-abortion group working to push even more extreme policies. The Southern Poverty Law Center describes FPA as "ultra conservative" and says its goals "largely involve changing public policy in Georgia to align with far-right anti-abortion and anti-LGBTQ ideologies." At the same time, their pro-rights, pro-democracy challengers, Jen Jordan and Miracle Rankin, announced their endorsements by Planned Parenthood Votes and Reproductive Freedom For All. This is the choice. And it could not be more stark. Life or death. Freedom or control. Rights protected--or taken away. Defend Our Courts has already proven what's possible with back-to-back wins in the Pennsylvania and Wisconsin Supreme Court races. Georgia is next, and it lays the foundation to flip Georgia's Supreme Court, but only if we act immediately. We are working to support a full-scale effort to reach voters across Georgia, but there is a critical funding gap that must be closed right now to keep this program fully operational. If we don't step in, this opportunity could slip away. == | | | | | == | == | == | == This election will decide more than a court. It will decide what kind of future Georgia's families face. subject: Voting is underway but MAGA plans to cancel our election

body:
In Louisiana, MAGA is set to cancel our May 16 election so they can conduct a Jim Crow gerrymander with the new powers granted to them by SCOTUS yesterday. They will then hold a new election on their
| | | | | [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001hd_OQ7NJqLnkJXcMM-d7hpRiRZ81DhUAzl4BMrJ-_h3c5buBTdCq-6uEkZoe9YrGq1zoqagzLTyN-m9uQ4-oBZFeAVYTKeq3WHdJw1Ql0IPctY6tooY_3ppCwuR6937rS29ZJAB4n86xcrtFMNTn68uitBcuOl6fO7GM5Pz_2Dn0vrLRRwOgcMpX-aFZQ0wvulkKqDkcn0SmsBAG7BF-atFhTvwQ5P_artzSQsFmnjA=&c=u2JZgb6Xua4JH5E9ITpYcyPRkMDg3JN2nyStgkJ8P7_kclrkn5dKCQ==&ch=UJN85gAMIgyPwSzGNyWpMUfgpXJF_Jjc167WGgRz6M_aVs93yhYsPg==)

Peter, Yesterday, the Supreme Court struck down the last vestiges of the legislation that ended Jim Crow, the Voting Rights Act.
Across red states, Republicans were quick to spring into action. Within hours of the ruling, Florida Republicans were able to introduce a new map that tore apart Florida's black majority districts and added 4 new GOP seats.
Yet no state was more egregious than Louisiana, where MAGA is now set to cancel our upcoming May 16th election, where voting is already underway. They plan to conduct a Jim Crow gerrymander to erase black districts with the new powers granted to them by SCOTUS yesterday and then hold a new election on their terms.
---
| [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001hd_OQ7NJqLnkJXcMM-d7hpRiRZ81DhUAzl4BMrJ-_h3c5buBTdCq-6uEkZoe9YrGq1zoqagzLTyN-m9uQ4-oBZFeAVYTKeq3WHdJw1Ql0IPctY6tooY_3ppCwuR6937rS29ZJAB4n86xcrtFMNTn68uitBcuOl6fO7GM5Pz_2Dn0vrLRRwOgcMpX-aFZQ0wvulkKqDkcn0SmsBAG7BF-aqXD4H0Y5RIA0aV3NCH2wqw=&c=u2JZgb6Xua4JH5E9ITpYcyPRkMDg3JN2nyStgkJ8P7_kclrkn5dKCQ==&ch=UJN85gAMIgyPwSzGNyWpMUfgpXJF_Jjc167WGgRz6M_aVs93yhYsPg==)
---
We are in completely uncharted waters. MAGA has taken the gloves off and is racing towards the reestablishment of Jim Crow in the deep south.
Our campaign for the US Senate will now not only have to raise money to continue building our campaign's GOTV program, but will now have to spend hundreds of thousands, if not millions, on a costly legal challenge against the cancellation of our election and the disenfranchisement of black Louisiana voters.
Louisiana is now at the epicenter of the fascist takeover of our nation. History shows that fascism takes root first very slowly and then all at once. When they start canceling elections, you know that we are at the all-at-once part.
What happens here will set the template for the rest of the country, and god help us if we aren't successful. [To survive, we need support from Democrats from across the nation. Please, rush a donation of whatever you can to our campaign so we can immediately put it towards stopping their effort and electing Louisiana's first black Senator. Our average donation is $25, many give more, some give less, the amount doesn't matter because they will add up.](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001hd_OQ7NJqLnkJXcMM-d7hpRiRZ81DhUAzl4BMrJ-_h3c5buBTdCq-6uEkZoe9YrGKU9g36z2V3EIo9NjzjQaL60ZhqgUr1A8oJDiWxkERJDOcmUrnbTzhDBQIpzXAukWAaJk_I4KHSZtJPVtXbgZ5ZyoPbb3-aqEOozGS7wr2RjIDftuiEm7oAj5p0vhlUDOLoor9k7sAlfBXPM_2NpWTLjliArkcAt7A-b-al7RtEFcJjFyRGrDoA==&c=u2JZgb6Xua4JH5E9ITpYcyPRkMDg3JN2nyStgkJ8P7_kclrkn5dKCQ==&ch=UJN85gAMIgyPwSzGNyWpMUfgpXJF_Jjc167WGgRz6M_aVs93yhYsPg==)

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

body:
| | | Friend, I’ve been hearing a claim on the campaign trail that needs a reality check. Some folks are trying to minimize my work and experience as a County Clerk. So let’s talk about what a county clerk for a large county does. I run elections for nearly half a million Colorado voters, which is more voters than there are in all of Wyoming. **It’s about four times as many voters as a senate district** and eight times as many as a house district. A whole lot of people have placed their trust in me for this role, and I take it very seriously. It’s also important to know that County Clerk is an executive leadership role, especially in a large county. I manage a $20 million budget and 114 staff, plus up to 1,000 temporary election workers each year. I interface with legislators, state agencies, election officials across the country, state and national media, and other leaders every day. **The Secretary of State is also an executive leadership role** and has a budget of a little more than $45 million and 150ish staff. At the same time, I won’t sugarcoat it: this race is going to be close, and there’s already a lot of outside money coming in to try to flip it. And with our end-of-month deadline tonight, this is one of those moments where a lot of small decisions add up in a big way. [ ]So before I lace up and get going, I wanted to ask: If you’re able, can you chip in $25 or whatever feels right to help us finish the month strong? - Jocelyn Sent from my iPhone

subject: I answered their questions directly
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Danielle Bethell PAC 20220 [Preferences](https://daniellebethell
body:
I approached this interview the same way I’ve approached this campaign, speaking directly about what I’ve actually done.
[](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aklikul-hhlrhljhit-r/) Friends,I recently sat down with KATU as part of their "Know Your Candidates" series, where each of us was asked the same set of questions about our background, the challenges facing Oregon, and how we would lead.[You can read the full interview here.](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aklikul-hhlrhljhit-y/)We're now less than three weeks from Election Day, and this is the stretch where campaigns either break through or fall behind.If you've been following this race and believe in what we're building, I need your help right now. [Please consider making a contribution today](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aklikul-hhlrhljhit-j/). We're working to raise $25,000 this week to help expand our voter contact efforts between now and Election Day. [DONATE TODAY](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aklikul-hhlrhljhit-t/) [](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aklikul-hhlrhljhit-i/) I approached this interview the same way I've approached this campaign, speaking directly about what I've actually done and how I would take that experience into the governor's office.As a Marion County Commissioner, I've spent the last several years working through the issues people are dealing with right now, mental health, addiction, homelessness, public safety, and affordability. That work requires more than ideas. It requires follow-through, coordination, and a willingness to take responsibility for outcomes.That's why I've been clear that I'm not stepping into something new. I'm asking for a promotion in the same line of work.In these final weeks, it comes down to reaching voters and staying in front of them while they're making their decisions.Your support makes that possible. [Can You Chip In Now?](https://daniellebethell.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aklikul-hhlrhljhit-d/) If you've already contributed, thank you. | | **Arizona Experiments to Speed up Election Results**
**By Justin Riemer, President, USGI, and Marshal Trigg, Junior Counsel, USGI** The 2020 presidential race [took four days to call](https://us.list-manage.com/oAtjXs6S6ML?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a). It took a week to determine which party controlled the House in [2022](https://us.list-manage.com/K_hXt8W7WKu?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a). This phenomenon erodes voter confidence without any benefit that couldn’t be achieved by counting votes more quickly. Heavy vote-by-mail states may tend to report results more slowly, but the pace is largely the product of policy choices that some states make and others have not.The menu of reforms has been well understood and “pre-processing” ballots is perhaps the most cited. Pre-processing is a broad term encompassing the various steps election officials may take before Election Day to prepare mail ballots for final tabulation: removal of ballots from outer and inner envelopes, duplication of ballots that are not machine readable, ballot scanning, and identity verification. Although some experts suggest its impact may be overstated, it demonstrably speeds up getting totals, especially in the crucial window [immediately after polls close](https://us.list-manage.com/BVN3a7J64Vc?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a). Identity verification is a core component in the process. In-person voting confirms identity up front and most of those votes are recorded immediately. In contrast, mail ballots defer verification until after submission, through signature matching, review of ballot envelope affidavits, etc. Although aided by technology such as the Agilis machine in Clark County, Nevada, signature verification requires significant human judgment and takes time to do properly. Of course, this along with the rest of pre-processing must be complete before officials can tabulate and report results.Arizona verifies identity through signature matching. It’s also a laggard in reporting election results, which is problematic given the extremely tight 2020 presidential race there and subsequent close races in the national spotlight. Although Arizona pre-processes, its effectiveness is muted by an increasing trend of voters there returning ballots in-person near or on Election Day (so-called “late earlies”). Maricopa officials stated that [nearly a fifth (290,735)](https://us.list-manage.com/hsDqGjD9GE1?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) of all votes cast there in the 2022 General Election were early ballots dropped off on Election Day. Officials then need to transport those ballots to a central location for processing (including signature verification), which results in Arizona processing fewer ballots before Election Day than in other states. A five-business-day ballot cure period for signature verification mismatches stretches the process further. In the upcoming election, Arizona will implement an innovative approach that may help. [Legislation](https://us.list-manage.com/bCFhE_p41iX?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) enacted in 2024 lets mail voters bypass signature matching by returning their ballot in person and presenting acceptable identification at a voting location. This could, in theory, speed up the process for counting Arizona’s mail ballots used by roughly 75% of the state’s voters. A recent [Votebeat](https://us.list-manage.com/l03Mz1kxc5T?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) article raises several caveats that may inhibit widespread adoption, including longer lines for voters who opt to show ID versus no lines for those who just drop them off. Nonetheless, this is an intriguing reform, and one adopted with broad bipartisan support, especially notable in a state beset by a rancorous partisan debate over elections policy. Although signature verification is better than no verification, it is not ideal. It simultaneously leads to the rejection of valid ballots and the acceptance of fraudulent ones. It also leads to more curing, which—again—further delays results and risks rejecting more ballots. Verifying mail voters’ identities through an objective identification standard is good for both access and integrity. If a voter goes to such trouble, why not just vote in-person? Most Arizonans are on a permanent absentee voting list and automatically receive a ballot, something unlikely to change anytime soon. The state is also known for lengthy ballots. Some voters may wish to complete their ballot at home at their own pace and then return it in person and avoid the risks of postal delivery delays and signature matching by using the ID verification option.Arizona is unlikely to be “Florida fast” in results reporting anytime soon but it’s at least proactively working on solutions. This is a good lesson in policymaking. Although implementing certain national best practices can produce quicker election results, solutions need to be tailored to each state’s idiosyncrasies and voting cultures. This legislation was. Here’s hoping officials implement it smoothly and that voters take advantage of it.

| | **Alabama** Governor Ivey [signed a new law](https://us.list-manage.com/lQ_vaqPrPaG?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) requiring the Board of Pardons and Paroles to provide clear information to individuals with felony convictions on how to restore their voting rights.**California** A woman [pleaded guilty to a misdemeanor](https://us.list-manage.com/Dmq4fQaDHue?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) after registering her dog to vote and casting ballots in the animal’s name in multiple elections. Prosecutors dropped several felony charges as part of a plea agreement. A [ballot measure to amend the state constitution](https://us.list-manage.com/ezZROR8krpP?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) to require voter ID for in-person voting and identification information for mail ballots qualified for the November 2026 ballot after supporters submitted enough signatures.California’s [slow vote count is fueling distrust and conspiracy theories,](https://us.list-manage.com/B1GNQw3_vj2?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) but election officials and experts disagree on whether and how it can be done more quickly.**Delaware** Governor Meyer [signed an executive order](https://us.list-manage.com/ZKkfZRgSrxp?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) creating a statewide election security task force charged with reviewing vulnerabilities, coordinating across agencies, and recommending safeguards to address threats such as cybersecurity risks and disinformation.**Florida** On April 29, the Florida legislature [passed](https://us.list-manage.com/Ei58KBfXN4m?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) a newly drawn congressional map Governor DeSantis unveiled that will likely give Republicans an extra four seats. DeSantis stated the map will bring a balance to the partisan lean of the state which has 1.5 million more registered Republicans than Democrats. **Georgia** Secretary of State Raffensperger [called for Macon County Elections Supervisor Tarshea Fudge-Riley to step aside](https://us.list-manage.com/1LRIJFt8WYa?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) after she was indicted on federal health care fraud charges, though she has remained in her position following her initial court appearance.Georgia reported [record-breaking turnout](https://us.list-manage.com/125nsT8AlJT?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) on the first day of early voting in its 2026 primary election, with more than 35,000 voters casting ballots in person—a 29% increase over 2022—alongside thousands of absentee ballots already received.**Maryland** Governor Moore [signed a package of laws](https://us.list-manage.com/IOF9pFCVhyU?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) including a new state Voting Rights Act allowing voters and the attorney general to challenge local election practices.**Michigan** The Department of Justice [sent a letter to Wayne County](https://us.list-manage.com/SzKUIdDdYHh?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) requesting extensive election records from the 2024 election, including ballots and related materials, citing its authority to investigate potential violations of federal election law and assess election integrity.**Mississippi** Ballotpedia [published a post-session roundup](https://us.list-manage.com/mnpqaeFdNf5?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) of Mississippi’s 2026 legislative activity, highlighting enactment of a law requiring annual citizenship checks of voter rolls using the federal SAVE database, along with seven additional election bills addressing absentee ballot deadlines, voting equipment restrictions, cybersecurity standards, and election administration.Governor Reeves has [announced](https://us.list-manage.com/KRiGe9TTSIv?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) a special session to consider drawing new voting maps in anticipation of the _Louisiana v. Callais_ Supreme Court ruling.__ **Missouri** A [poll of Missouri voters](https://us.list-manage.com/10sxMVShgNf?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) found broad support for key election policies, including photo ID requirements and expanded in-person absentee voting, alongside high confidence that the state’s elections will be administered fairly.**New Jersey** Newark’s [pilot allowing 16- and 17-year-olds to vote](https://us.list-manage.com/Bdh00pH_XeE?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) in a municipal election drew just 45 participants—under 4% of eligible minors—despite requiring more than $1 million in system updates to enable under-18 registration.**North Carolina** Following a data comparison using the SAVE database, the State Board of Elections [identified nearly 34,000 deceased individuals on the voter rolls](https://us.list-manage.com/CgaOuIdw1Oe?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a). The State Board will now work with the relevant county officials to properly remove the deceased individuals in accordance with federal and state law. The State Board of Elections [approved new rules](https://us.list-manage.com/19Szq2HNMAQ?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) expanding the process for challenging suspected noncitizen voters and implementing matching through the federal government’s SAVE database.The State Board of Elections [dismissed a complaint](https://us.list-manage.com/RMb7F_4dmXm?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) against Cumberland County Elections Chair Linda Devore, finding insufficient evidence of election law violations and noting many allegations involved conduct outside her tenure or beyond the scope of election law.**Pennsylvania** Auditor General DeFoor [released a performance audit](https://us.list-manage.com/QmS2s2AMgOv?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) finding the state’s Motor Voter system generally functions as intended, but suffers from weaknesses in internal controls and data accuracy, prompting recommendations to strengthen security and oversight. One such example included a noncitizen who was permitted to apply to register due to human error.A state House Committee has advanced [legislation](https://us.list-manage.com/OKTuITfP0RE?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) that would permit mail ballot pre-processing. Similar past legislation has failed. Attorney General Sunday announced that Guillermo Sainz, who organized voter registration efforts for an Arizona based voter registration company, will serve a [30 day prison term and nearly a year of probation](https://us.list-manage.com/jC149_AzPUK?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) for offering financial incentives to canvassers during a voter registration drive. Sainz was charged last year with three counts of solicitation of registration**South Carolina** The State Election Commission [voted to enter a memorandum of understanding](https://us.list-manage.com/14T3qhklL7G?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) with the DOJ to share the state’s voter registration list, allowing federal officials to review the data for potential noncitizen or ineligible registrations while requiring encryption and state verification before any action is taken.**South Dakota** State and local election officials [clashed over how to handle a delay in early and absentee voting](https://us.list-manage.com/13Wr0K2WZrP?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) for the June 2 primary, with county auditors rejecting state guidance to use sample ballots and warning that conflicting legal interpretations created “chaos” over how to proceed.**Tennessee** Tennessee voters [will see new language on primary ballot applications](https://us.list-manage.com/fihdA13P0ki?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) requiring them to affirm they are “bona fide” members of, or declare allegiance to, the party whose ballot they select.**Texas** Lubbock County [implemented emergency ballot procedures](https://us.list-manage.com/NMSSGtydnEt?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) after widespread voting machine failures disrupted the first day of early voting, with officials unable to identify the cause at the time and working with vendors to restore functionality.**Virginia** State and federal lawsuits over Virginia Beach’s voting system [were dismissed as moot](https://us.list-manage.com/14YsTHa5e0z?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) after the legislature codified the city’s 10-district system in its charter, resolving disputes over its prior use and challenges to alternative election structures.Virginia voters [approved a constitutional amendment](https://us.list-manage.com/Fzs8K2K7fqf?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) allowing mid-decade congressional redistricting following months of litigation and political disputes, though the measure’s implementation remains subject to ongoing legal challenges.**Washington** King County [launched an investigation](https://us.list-manage.com/vbBksusQ0Ph?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) after roughly 500 unvoted ballots from prior election cycles were found near a Renton dumpster, with officials stating the ballots were undelivered mail that had not been received by voters.Ballotpedia [published a post-session roundup](https://us.list-manage.com/dTcSvR360QW?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) of Washington’s 2026 legislative activity, highlighting lawmakers’ updates to the state voting rights act and passage of eight additional election-related bills addressing election administration, voter access, and procedural reforms. **West Virginia** Ballotpedia [published a post-session roundup](https://us.list-manage.com/12_LQE6ymcQ?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) of West Virginia’s 2026 legislative activity, highlighting lawmakers’ decision to place a constitutional amendment on the ballot requiring U.S. citizenship for voting, along with enactment of multiple additional election bills addressing voter ID, administration, and election procedures.**Wisconsin** Wisconsin prosecutors [charged a Rothschild man](https://us.list-manage.com/w2Bxa_7K19e?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) with felony election fraud for allegedly voting in the April 2025 election while on felony supervision and falsely certifying his eligibility during same-day registration.Green Bay [asked the Wisconsin Elections Commission](https://us.list-manage.com/YrUCdXitNVN?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) to dismiss a complaint alleging duplicate absentee ballots, stating that, while about 152 voters were mistakenly sent multiple ballots due to a printing error, the city’s efforts ensured that no duplicate votes were counted.**Wyoming** A state court [dismissed a lawsuit](https://us.list-manage.com/h_2SYOkqE2B?e=c16f400a56&c2id=fe0a341e6e6069e01834adfd2665567a) seeking to remove Weston County Clerk Becky Hadlock after she resigned following felony charges alleging she mishandled election records, rendering the action moot.
