Turns out the government can save money... when someone actually checks the receipts. | | | Apr 30 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- The year 2025 will be remembered as a watershed moment in government contracting, largely thanks to the Department of Government Efficiency's revolutionary approach to federal acquisition. What began as a controversial presidential initiative evolved into a powerful force for fiscal responsibility, saving taxpayers nearly $1 billion while delivering lessons in procurement innovation that will shape government operations for decades to come. The Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), established early in 2025, was tasked with an ambitious mandate: identify and eliminate wasteful spending throughout the federal procurement system. Led by former business leaders and efficiency experts, DOGE approached its mission not with random cost-cutting, but with systematic analysis of government contracts across all departments. According to Washington Technology's analysis of DOGE's impact, the initiative "was government contracting's biggest story in 2025, and it's not close." This assessment reflects how comprehensively DOGE changed the conversation around federal spending. The first major breakthrough came in early 2025 when federal agencies implemented DOGE's recommendations to cut 103 contracts, resulting in immediate savings of $103 million, as reported by Executive Gov. These weren't reckless cuts but strategic terminations of poorly performing, redundant, or overpriced agreements that had escaped scrutiny for years. Perhaps more impressive was DOGE's success in identifying and eliminating 55 contracts with a combined ceiling value of $863 million. As GovCon Wire detailed, these cancellations represented the most significant consolidation of federal procurement activity in recent history. What made these cuts particularly noteworthy was their precision--targeting long-standing inefficient contracts without affecting necessary services Beyond simple contract cancellations, DOGE introduced game-changing procurement methodologies that prioritized value over tradition. The initiative championed: Data-driven decision making : Implementing advanced analytics to identify poorly performing contracts and cost overruns before they became problematic. Performance-based contracting : Shifting focus from process compliance to actual results, with clearer metrics and accountability mechanisms. Strategic sourcing : Encouraging interagency collaboration to leverage purchasing power across the government ecosystem. Streamlined acquisition processes : Reducing administrative burdens that had historically inflated contract costs by up to 15%-20%. Critics initially warned that DOGE's aggressive efficiency targets would harm government services and disrupt important programs. However, the evidence from 2025 tells a different story. By carefully analyzing contract performance data and focusing on eliminating redundancy rather than reducing essential services, DOGE managed to cut costs while maintaining-- and in some cases improving--service delivery. A particularly compelling example comes from the Department of Health and Human Services, where DOGE helped consolidate 12 separate IT maintenance contracts into three more efficient agreements. This consolidation saved approximately $21 million annually while actually improving system uptime and user satisfaction scores. The financial savings delivered by DOGE in 2025 are certainly impressive--nearly $1 billion in avoided costs represents a significant return on taxpayer investment. However, the initiative's most lasting impact may be cultural rather than fiscal. "DOGE dumped all of the Medicaid Data and it shows that a Sole Proprietor operating in a van in rural New Mexico has billed $76 MILLION dollars in 7 years...averaging thousands of claims per day...and a Pediatrician who billed Medicaid 830 claims per day..." DOGE introduced a new mindset across government agencies: that every expenditure must be justified not by tradition or precedent, but by demonstrated value. This philosophical shift has already begun changing how agencies approach procurement, with increased emphasis on: Outcome-based contract structures Regular performance reviews Competition and market research Transparency in pricing and decision-making As we move into 2026, government contractors and federal employees alike are adapting to a new reality shaped by DOGE's 2025 successes. The initiative has proven that thoughtful, data-driven efficiency measures can achieve substantial savings without compromising essential government functions. Perhaps the most valuable lesson from DOGE's first year is that government efficiency isn't a partisan issue--it's a pragmatic one. By focusing on measurable results rather than political ideology, DOGE has created an approach to government improvement that can withstand changes in administration and continue evolving as new technologies and methodologies emerge. For American taxpayers, DOGE represents something rare in government: a bold experiment that actually delivered on its promises. In an era of skepticism about federal competence, the 2025 story of DOGE offers a hopeful narrative about what's possible when government commits to doing better with the resources it already has. The Department of Government Efficiency's transformative impact in 2025 demonstrates a fundamental truth: with the right leadership, tools, and approach, government can indeed become more efficient without sacrificing effectiveness. The nearly $1 billion in savings tells only part of the story--perhaps more significant is the cultural shift toward accountability, performance, and value that DOGE introduced throughout the federal procurement system. As agencies continue to implement and refine these efficiency initiatives, the savings and improvements will likely compound in the years ahead. For anyone concerned about fiscal responsibility and good governance, DOGE's first year offers a rare piece of genuinely good news from Washington. It had a reimbursement rate that was among the highest in the country and zero accreditation requirements for the companies billing it. Out-of-state operators set up shop. Individual clinicians billing Medicaid grew from 389 to over 2,700. The state had no system to verify whether therapy actually happened. Indiana's federal audit sampled 100 months of ABA claims. Every single one contained at least one improper payment. Not 97. All 100. Nap time billed as treatment. Group therapy billed as individual. Unqualified staff. Missing documentation. Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. My end-of-month deadline is just hours away, and **_[in a moment, I'm going to ask you to rush $5 to help me close the gap on my $50,000 goal](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7647?refcode=jtk620-fr-nd&t=2&akid=9312%2E400544%2EeTAZ6Z)_**. But before I do that, can I (briefly) tell you my story?

And it led me to become one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and, later on, the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history!
History has shown us that there's nothing we can't accomplish if we work together. **No state in America has ever elected a Native American woman as Governor — but with your support, I know we can change that.

name: Nico, United We Dream
subject: More than 80 DACA recipients have been deported
body:
DACA protections have been further eroded. | | | Peter,
Immigrant youth were promised protection from deportation under DACA, but the threats to DACA are stacking up — one by one — creating a cascading crisis that is putting the entire program at risk. **A three-judge panel on the Board of Immigration Appeals recently ruled that DACA alone is not enough to prevent deportation, which raises serious concerns for the hundreds of thousands of young people who have relied on this protection.** DACA protects immigrant youth from detention and deportation. But that promise has been broken too many times. DACA recipients who are supposed to be protected from detention and deportation have been targeted. Hundreds of DACA recipients across the country have been illegally detained and more than 80 have been deported. As DACA endures unprecedented legal, political, and administrative attacks, this decision further erodes the stability families depend on and puts jobs, education, and everyday lives at risk. United We Dream is fighting for permanent protections. We’re organizing trainings and mass mobilizations to push lawmakers to act. But we cannot do this without your help. **Peter, we will not stop pressuring lawmakers to deliver permanent protections to the hundreds of thousands of DACA recipients who power our economy and country.** **[Will you help fuel our advocacy efforts? Chip in to United We Dream. clean_body: DACA protections have been further eroded. | | | Peter, Immigrant youth were promised protection from deportation under DACA, but the threats to DACA are stacking up — one by one — creating a cascading crisis that is putting the entire program at risk. A three-judge panel on the Board of Immigration Appeals recently ruled that DACA alone is not enough to prevent deportation, which raises serious concerns for the hundreds of thousands of young people who have relied on this protection. DACA protects immigrant youth from detention and deportation. But that promise has been broken too many times. DACA recipients who are supposed to be protected from detention and deportation have been targeted. Hundreds of DACA recipients across the country have been illegally detained and more than 80 have been deported. As DACA endures unprecedented legal, political, and administrative attacks, this decision further erodes the stability families depend on and puts jobs, education, and everyday lives at risk. United We Dream is fighting for permanent protections. We’re organizing trainings and mass mobilizations to push lawmakers to act. But we cannot do this without your help. Peter, we will not stop pressuring lawmakers to deliver permanent protections to the hundreds of thousands of DACA recipients who power our economy and country. Ensuring Northwest Washington is a place where people can afford to live, work, and build a future.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130482288/617917821/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MjAxODVlYy1iYTQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d5GmD0ramSkXiQz8OvK0fc6HbFxpq8pYFwd7mGTcsHk=&emci=086522a3-933e-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=820185ec-ba44-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=9494239)

| | Across Northwest Washington, families are feeling the strain of rising costs. Groceries are more expensive. Energy bills are harder to manage. Housing remains out of reach for too many people. **For workers, seniors, and small business owners alike, the cost of living is more than just a headline, but a daily struggle**. This is the challenge that continues to guide my work. **I am focused on lowering costs in ways that make a tangible difference in people's lives. Over the last two months, that meant:**
* Pushing back against tariffs and policies that drive up prices on everyday goods
* Supporting investments that strengthen our supply chains and protect jobs here at home
* Fighting for economic policies that put working families first, not corporate profits

In Northwest Washington, affordability is closely tied to the strength of our regional economy. Our communities depend on good-paying jobs in industries like aerospace, trade, and manufacturing. When those jobs are stable and growing, families have more security and opportunity. **That is why I am working to support job growth, invest in infrastructure, and ensure that federal resources are coming back to our region.** But affordability is not just about wages. It is about the full picture of what people need to live with dignity. That includes access to reliable transportation, affordable housing, quality health care, childcare, and strong public services. It also means preparing our communities for challenges like climate impacts that can drive up costs even further. [**There is more work to do, and it will require building a campaign that can continue to deliver results and stand up for Northwest Washington. clean_body: Ensuring Northwest Washington is a place where people can afford to live, work, and build a future. | | | | Across Northwest Washington, families are feeling the strain of rising costs. Groceries are more expensive. Energy bills are harder to manage. Housing remains out of reach for too many people. For workers, seniors, and small business owners alike, the cost of living is more than just a headline, but a daily struggle. This is the challenge that continues to guide my work. I am focused on lowering costs in ways that make a tangible difference in people's lives. Over the last two months, that meant: Pushing back against tariffs and policies that drive up prices on everyday goods Supporting investments that strengthen our supply chains and protect jobs here at home Fighting for economic policies that put working families first, not corporate profits In Northwest Washington, affordability is closely tied to the strength of our regional economy. Our communities depend on good-paying jobs in industries like aerospace, trade, and manufacturing. When those jobs are stable and growing, families have more security and opportunity. That is why I am working to support job growth, invest in infrastructure, and ensure that federal resources are coming back to our region. But affordability is not just about wages. It is about the full picture of what people need to live with dignity. That includes access to reliable transportation, affordable housing, quality health care, childcare, and strong public services. name: President Fatima Heyward via ActionNetwork.org
subject: Emergency Briefing on the Voting Rights Act
body:
Get the facts. Join the DNC Briefing on May 4th. | | |
Hello Derek, Yesterday was a difficult day for our democracy. The Supreme Court has issued its ruling in Louisiana v. Callais, and we must be clear about what it means and what we are going to do. The Supreme Court has removed the core requirement of the Voting Rights Act, which was to protect minority opportunity districts. In today's 6-3 ruling in Louisiana v. Callais, the Court struck down Louisiana's second majority-Black congressional district and sharply narrowed Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act, the provision that has long protected underrepresented communities from discriminatory gerrymandering. **This will have a significant impact on Black, Indigenous, Latino, and AANHPI representation, especially in the South.** The government should protect its people, not strip away their freedom, equality, and right to be represented. Every injustice has consequences, and this November, we are taking our country back. **This moment demands more than outrage. It demands action.** The Young Democrats of America will not lose hope, will not be divided, and will not be worn down. We will organize, speak out, and fight back. Most importantly, we all must VOTE. Bring your family, your neighbors, everyone. The ballot is our most powerful weapon, and it is time we use it. **I am asking you to take one more step right now.****J****oin the DNC for a virtual briefing on voting rights and Louisiana v. Callais on Sunday, May 4th.** The briefing will include DNC Chair Ken Martin and Civic Engagement and Voter Protection Director Herly Rosemond, who will break down exactly how Democrats are fighting tooth and nail to ensure the voices of all Americans are heard in November and in every election that follows. In addition, the meeting will include Davante Lewis, Louisiana Public Service Commissioner (District 3); Cliff Albright, Co-founder of Black Voters Matter Fund; and Charles Taylor, Executive Director of the NAACP Mississippi State Conference. I hope to see you there. **
Fatima Heyward**
President, Young Democrats of America**

name: Chris Pappas
subject: Something is broken
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=6402%2E582294%2Ef7nfBl ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=6402%2E582294%2Ef7nfBl ]Chris Pappas for Senate

We need to
talk about what’s wrong with Washington today.

When Granite Staters voted John Sununu out of the Senate for selling out
New Hampshire to corporate special interests, he was worth less than $1
million. But after he left Washington, he cashed in with those same
corporate special interests, working for a lobbying firm and sitting on
corporate boards. Now? He’s worth nearly $37 million.

And he wants his old job back.

Sununu has made it clear he’d be a reliable vote for Donald Trump’s agenda
in the Senate – the same agenda that’s out of step with New Hampshire and
focused on enriching the wealthy and well-connected.

The corporate boards and lobbying groups Sununu has spent years serving
are going to spend whatever it takes to help him buy his way back in.
We’re doing things differently by building a campaign powered by people
like you.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260430_2.x5HLp3&refcode=em20260430-2&t=1003&akid=6402%2E582294%2Ef7nfBl ]In just 12 hours, we face our biggest end-of-month fundraising deadline
of this campaign yet. Can I count on you to contribute $5
before midnight tonight to help us fight back against the flood of GOP
cash and close our critical fundraising gap?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260430_2.x5HLp3&amount=5&refcode=em20260430-2&t=1004&akid=6402%2E582294%2Ef7nfBl ]Donate $5 »

When
public office becomes a path to personal profit, something is broken.

Here’s the difference between me and my opponent:

I grew up here in New Hampshire, working in my family’s small business. I
learned early on that you show up, you do the work, and you answer to the
people you serve.

Meanwhile national Republicans and outside groups are already pouring
money into New Hampshire to try and buy this seat. But we have something
our opponent doesn’t — a formidable, passionate grassroots team.

Our campaign is powered by people across New Hampshire — teachers, nurses,
small business owners, and veterans chipping in what they can when they
can — because they want a government that actually works for them.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260430_2.x5HLp3&refcode=em20260430-2&t=1005&akid=6402%2E582294%2Ef7nfBl ]We’ve got real momentum right now, and it means a lot to have you as
part of our team. Will you step up today with $5 (or more!)
before our end-of-month deadline to fuel our campaign and keep New
Hampshire blue?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260430_2.x5HLp3&amount=5&refcode=em20260430-2&t=1024&akid=6402%2E582294%2Ef7nfBl ]Donate $5 »

Thank you,

Chris Pappas

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=6402%2E582294%2Ef7nfBl

Friend, I'm going to be blunt.
**_What's going on? _**
❌ We’re watching Republicans cover up the truth about Epstein.
❌ We’re watching ICE agents terrorize communities and families.
❌ We’re watching attacks on voting rights ramp up across the country.
**And yet... not enough people are stepping up to hold them accountable. Donations have plummeted at the worst possible moment!**

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
The Atlantic: Donald Trump’s Plan to Subvert the Midterms Is Already Under Way [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=043026_2&amount=25]
Team, that headline from The Atlantic says it all.
Donald Trump already promised as part of his 2024 campaign that “we’ll have it fixed so good, you’re not gonna have to vote .” Watching his actions after he lost in 2020 -- lies, denial, rallies, all leading to January 6th -- it's not hard to imagine what he's got in mind for November.
Our states run our elections. But that doesn't mean that MAGA-aligned politicians won't follow his illegal orders to interfere. It doesn't stop him from using ICE agents to intimidate at the polls or threaten eligible voters. And it doesn't stop his Department of Justice from trying to interfere through the courts, especially when more than half of the suppressive lawsuits brought to court this year were brought by the very federal department that's supposed to protect our rights.
None of that takes into account the highly partisan efforts for mid-decade redistricting as well. It's clear that the threats to the next election aren't going to stop. That's where we come in.
We must inform voters, defend our elections, and make sure every eligible vote counts. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to fuel our voting rights work for 2026 and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=043026_2&amount=35]

Our democracy, our elections, and our fundamental right to vote have been under attack for more than a decade. Our electoral system is reaching a breaking point, and it's hard to predict exactly where the next set of electoral shenanigans will come from.
Are we destined to watch our elections break down? Absolutely not. We still have the time and the people to win. What we need most is the resources to carry on this fight for our democracy and the work to make every voice heard in our elections.
Stopping their attempts to subvert the midterms will require courage and integrity across the board. Most of all, it will depend on individual Americans like us to stand up for our rights and demand that our votes are counted.
This is a fight we can and will win. Stand with us to protect the right to vote by pitching in with $35 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=043026_2&amount=35]

Peter, There are no words. For decades now, the Roberts Supreme Court has worked to dismantle the landmark Voting Rights Act, piece by piece. And yesterday, the packed, radical majority effectively gutted the law’s key provision that barred racial discrimination, including racial gerrymandering. **What happened next is why we’re writing.** _Within hours of this decision_ , Florida voted on a new, extreme gerrymander to try to snatch up four extra Republican seats in Congress. And Republicans across the country started openly scheming to redraw their congressional maps to ensure districts that represent communities of color — especially Black Americans — are written out of existence. U.S. Senator Marsha Blackburn, who is running for Tennessee Governor, called immediately for the state legislature to redistrict. Georgia Lt. Governor Burt Jones and State Senator Greg Dolezal called for the same in Georgia. Peter, there are no words capable of capturing the outrage of this moment. **But there _is_ action. ** And as we’ve shown time after time, since the Republicans started the national redistricting crisis, when we fight back tooth and nail, we can stop their power grab in its tracks. clean_body: We will fight like hell to ensure our democracy survives | Peter, There are no words. For decades now, the Roberts Supreme Court has worked to dismantle the landmark Voting Rights Act, piece by piece. And yesterday, the packed, radical majority effectively gutted the law’s key provision that barred racial discrimination, including racial gerrymandering. What happened next is why we’re writing. Within hours of this decision , Florida voted on a new, extreme gerrymander to try to snatch up four extra Republican seats in Congress. And Republicans across the country started openly scheming to redraw their congressional maps to ensure districts that represent communities of color — especially Black Americans — are written out of existence. U.S. Senator Marsha Blackburn, who is running for Tennessee Governor, called immediately for the state legislature to redistrict. Georgia Lt. Governor Burt Jones and State Senator Greg Dolezal called for the same in Georgia. Peter, there are no words capable of capturing the outrage of this moment. But there is action. And as we’ve shown time after time, since the Republicans started the national redistricting crisis, when we fight back tooth and nail, we can stop their power grab in its tracks. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = We’ll level with you: We’re horrified by this decision, but we aren’t surprised. Friday evening at 6:45 pm, there will be a screening in Silver Spring, Maryland of the new documentary about legendary journalist Amy Goodman called "Steal This Story, Please!" I've heard it's truly excellent.
[After the screening, I'll be doing a Q&A with Amy herself, ](https://substack.com/redirect/028550d8-2886-40ae-a0ab-079fec264905?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)a real privilege. (If you have any questions I should put to her, you can reply to this and let me know.)
The event doubles as a fundraiser for Howard University's PBS station and tickets are (just under) $50. I'm told they have about 100 left and whatever they haven't sold goes back to the theater by 5:00 p.m. ET today. So if you'd like to see the film and also support Howard's PBS station, please get your ticket this afternoon through this [Eventbrite link](https://substack.com/redirect/028550d8-2886-40ae-a0ab-079fec264905?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
If you live outside of the DC area, my apologies for bothering you with this.

Friend, Workers across the country are rising up for change, as Americans struggle to put food on the table, keep a roof over their heads, and get the healthcare they need. **This week I joined workers and my colleagues in Congress to launch the**** _Living Wage for All Act,_****which would increase the federal minimum wage to $25 an hour to account for rising costs.** This change is long overdue. The bill also establishes a standard to keep growing the minimum wage over time and, if passed, would eliminate all subminimum wages—which currently exploit tipped workers, youth, and disabled people. I’m a proud daughter of a union family, and I will continue to support workers and champion pro-worker legislation while challenging corporate greed. **Tomorrow, I’m joining workers in**[**celebrating and taking action for May Day**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.A3cd-kVlFz1CzUMSYeTvVRA7TvHoN-iBBgbylyHKJaWMbgZOdFg0r_SdTKRejTyNLJ7ROIzuSxkRnnNcKvj4c0-nwniYxhHfIpt0wAVpQa8aAS4TSX7Ktud3mvWTAuK-9w78O4YKkcJXLJ6JBAbEVeTmm6YGE7MTW9rgqzVRvhGvxh8l4lNURveaoBt34gbUG_WHOX92WQHhR24LqTIjXEft2lNGnRP0_4whBeVgobNL6IN8tvkHnLIyqQW2DZLl5pVpnHBZZ2QLqODuUqOS7CiYkjXGuoAvmG_ghQuV0LalivEmizyGreOIjSZEPVUN/4q8/dmXR0B7fR6-jxK6k-po5LQ/h1/h001.OoYPqqqnpMZ6oj5XpKitKb41pb5auhkzyTjJpRIR0Dc)**, also known as International Workers’ Day.** Hundreds of organizations are coming together to demand a nation that puts workers over billionaires by:
* **Taxing the rich to fund people’s needs** like housing, healthcare, food assistance, public schools, and universal childcare. Corporations and the ultra-wealthy have worked to rig the system to avoid paying their share of taxes, and their wealth keeps growing while life gets harder for the rest of us. That needs to end.
* **Abolishing ICE and ending war:** We don’t want our tax dollars funding a private army that’s serving authoritarian power and kidnapping, attacking, and killing our neighbors.
* **Expanding democracy: Hands off our vote!** We won’t stand for Trump’s proposed takeover of our elections, and we’ll keep pushing back against attacks, such as this week’s racist Supreme Court decision to further destroy the _Voting Rights Act_.

[**If you agree that we need urgent action, please click here to find a May Day rally or march near you and sign up to attend tomorrow.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.A3cd-kVlFz1CzUMSYeTvVRA7TvHoN-iBBgbylyHKJaVB3gU0Of3-Xp96bvL9eqr5T7syjYulpA-IL2Ht2I9VemR_dvhee6MKdZHLkq8G0nlWScLNmF1QML1gDqbBD2Is0tRTShcgu-ZzPhNb7LPXtLBaCrERxo8DCwQUwyeS9sZ4GUGISFvk3PEdiAO2kGtKKSRmRNjdtPpg0IM4pzAPpCx-B4wH3tf2N6Xs5AeQzbadGolFpsQCVJtUNlcUhN1Y6lFmTVClB-_TAe7jToyFFssNb242VIcTV6TRijUQ0htq8HM-mMcUxHWy-wmliUIL/4q8/dmXR0B7fR6-jxK6k-po5LQ/h2/h001.AakpEfWxkLII0deRQ_PTEv3KdSKsew4jz1MddN_RaoI) | [SIGN UP FOR TOMORROW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.A3cd-kVlFz1CzUMSYeTvVRA7TvHoN-iBBgbylyHKJaVBz5KGT9voxkDTLPlDwsLJkY0xE6IHSR91nFctdEO0dC-hvkT_uTAZNMvs-bDFmxpR4MnBVJFLoPmfoN-H7DopraEc__Luvo2cRJULgRZcfYAQ4r_93NncX1lPZ_URjo3gnw2kzOgnX9ucOKy9SQPG0FH-pBUugDH-817KhX0fnafYBbJCQ9p7_JlANCXLGrGaO-sRF4V7BOZ68rKfsKWgnGNpqwu0OSoGi2TRQ3wgtz_UcptJu4-33EkpigfqTEi3uKKWRAkUjz4VTr9hP--7/4q8/dmXR0B7fR6-jxK6k-po5LQ/h3/h001.I_KypNG0jpl8t3cgdYcUHZv89Ti3vMVUeUi5tmewzKM)

May Day started here in the United States after 80,000 people showed up to rally and demand the 8-hour work day in Chicago’s Haymarket Square in 1886. Police attacked and killed protesters, and then framed primarily immigrant workers for violence (who were later pardoned).
These Haymarket events sparked yearly worldwide celebrations of the labor movement on May 1, beginning in the late 1800s.
But because of nationwide suppression of our labor movement, it took until 1937 to pass a federal law protecting the 8-hour workday. We’re still fighting for workers’ rights today.
**Unlike many of my colleagues in Congress, I grew up in a working class family.** When my dad joined the United Auto Workers (UAW), he ensured we had health insurance for the first time.
**I understand how urgently we need transformative changes, and I stand firmly with workers and the labor movement.**
I’m proud that unions have already endorsed our 2026 re-election campaign, including National Nurses United, the National Education Association, the American Federation Of Government Employees Local 704, the Association of Flight Attendants, and UNITE HERE! Local 24.
In the U.S. House Committee on Financial Services, I’ve held Wall Street and corporate executives accountable. And at home, my team has held “organize your workplace” trainings with workers from Amazon, Starbucks, and more.
**I will continue leading transformative policies to end poverty, meet people’s needs, and save lives—including:**
* **The**** _Stop Price Gouging in Grocery Stores Act,_****** which has over 70 cosponsors and has been endorsed by the United Food and Commercial Workers International Union (UFCW).
* **Bills to cancel medical debt and utility debt** , in addition to legislation that helps families pay for utilities including drinking water.
* **The**** _Tax_********_Excessive_********_CEO_********_Pay_********_Act_** , which would raise**** taxes on corporations that pay their executives more than 50 times the wages of their workers.
* **The**** _Restaurant Workers Bill of Rights_** , which would end the subminimum wage for tipped workers (it has remained stuck at $2.13 an hour for over 30 years). I introduced this in partnership with worker members of the Restaurant Opportunities Centers (ROC) United.
* **The****Economic Dignity For All Agenda** to help ensure that every family and child has the resources needed to flourish, by providing regular cash assistance directly to individuals and families nationwide.

Our movement is growing. Last year marked the most May Day events in U.S. history, so let’s keep up the momentum and demonstrate our power this year.
[**Find a May Day event near you for tomorrow—Friday, May 1, 2026.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.A3cd-kVlFz1CzUMSYeTvVRA7TvHoN-iBBgbylyHKJaXXvQjUJ4DWulzDSFClV7Nj_D21qA94x1xkyMtPp3sipT-0xOkemddfFtsk6rx04wC1EBjF8r2UP3p5RzlMUe2xK547wLerNisIT_k4cNIq9UHg5eBz9wABGyvWbe7WnC501PjURxXfRZNwNSZQhTnkF4dBskxd6CJyeV-fcHWymVgtyJ79l3k0sYXs277ISVed_B1HGaiKzDHBQY09OjTF_MFXwnxubVyFSUj9LB9RvUVY2ktwQOyusfoss0rp92WfwC88nzbhYJ3C1zGW7wqH/4q8/dmXR0B7fR6-jxK6k-po5LQ/h4/h001.4jhlUYa8KiLH0MXOxxo6leLOftromb7GSEKB4BwffJA)
You can also check out [https://maydaystrong.org/](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.A3cd-kVlFz1CzUMSYeTvVRA7TvHoN-iBBgbylyHKJaVzCC0TeSQHHOU0-bRrpH-zKcfbuC1pz6CWB_M5VoErjDLb12l0B9yIh-lTWxZG46AaaWKxrCVwjpyrHNRe7IC3kIM57OAvxM1nIiUYe8-neMUWMh_3UCgayDoDdBKbA1hozYs1Par8RJJB2Y16v6HvG7n5VpPV382VsFlhUGtkHsz_764pb2XTb_DOLtwmr4BMHX-8YkZs7N982V3fuaRRrtB9f4z6xOvBlW_LSz5d8CCFJETD1eBpGETuxtLbUekd999ylXGaJjY0Ius7Dafl/4q8/dmXR0B7fR6-jxK6k-po5LQ/h5/h001.fdYbGSpFncjcePa3uv7kr4JA8ETgu5k7tKcufkU5MUo) to find out more about tomorrow’s National Day of Action for Workers Over Billionaires, and about the coalition of organizations and unions promoting it.
Together, we’ll keep fighting for the rights and dignity of all people, and for a thriving democracy that works for all of us.
We’ll keep building the world we need and deserve.
In solidarity,
Rashida

subject: angry about Supreme Court ruling? here's how we fight back

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240819%2E444211%2EhxlOwT)
Yesterday’s Callais ruling — which destroyed what was left of the Voting Right Act — was published at the same time that I was meeting, registering and committing to work with new voters at Austin Community College.
It’s one of dozens of campuses across Texas where our Powered by People volunteers are organizing to win political power in November.
If anything, this Supreme Court decision makes clear that we have to work harder, stay longer, push through until we reach every eligible voter... a personal conversation with each one about the stakes of this election... and make sure they’re registered, and stay with them through Election Day.
We don’t control the Supreme Court (that’s Trump), but we do control how we spend our days. And the volunteers I worked with at ACC are using this time to build the political power to elect a Congress that will check this court and empower an electorate that will replace MAGA authoritarianism with a government of, by and for the people.
Those in power want us to feel overpowered, outgunned, defeated. And I know many were tempted to despair yesterday. But this is our chance to show them what we’re made of and what we can do.
Don’t complain, don’t wait for someone to save us, don’t distract yourself with social media outrage. Nothing will get us out of this and into the next round but the work.
[**If you want to reach, register and turn out the voters they’re trying to disenfranchise by gutting the Voting Rights Act, donate to support our volunteers in the field who are doing just that.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260430-1.cq61ZM&refcode=ema20260430-240819&t=3&akid=240819%2E444211%2EhxlOwT)
**[Donate $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260430-1.cq61ZM&refcode=ema20260430-240819&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=240819%2E444211%2EhxlOwT)**
All day yesterday we were meeting people who never got registered, whose registrations lapsed, who were registered but never voted... and in every case we got them ready to vote (registered and updated), had conversations with them about what’s most important to them, connected that to voting and then committed to staying in touch to help them with any question or issue around voting and elections. And we will also be in touch every day during early voting until we confirm they’ve cast their ballot.
We do this every day, all over Texas. Monday I joined our volunteers at San Antonio College and UT San Antonio. Tuesday we were at Texas State in San Marcos. And today I’ll meet up with our team at UT El Paso.
It’s a lot of work, but it works! Young Texas voters statewide in 2024: 37% turnout. Young Texas voters in our program in 2024: 79%.
Action is the antidote, the key to victory.
Keep pushing.
Beto

We are well into President Trump’s second term, and House Republicans are working around the clock to deliver on the America First promises that voters demanded. The Democrats and their radical allies are already pouring millions into Michigan to stall our momentum. They want to obstruct our agenda and take back control of the House in the upcoming midterms so they can return to the failed policies of the past. I am fighting every day to protect your freedoms, grow our economy, and rebuild Michigan into a powerhouse of opportunity. But I need you in this fight with me. | By standing with Team Walberg, you are defending the values that define our state: hard work, fiscal responsibility, and a commitment to the next generation. We have a historic opportunity to enact the full MAGA agenda, but it requires a strong Republican majority that won’t back down. Every seat is a battlefield, and the fight for the future of our country starts right here in Michigan. Thank you for your continued support and for standing for our values. This is exactly what we're up against: Republicans are trying to hold the U.S. House majority by tilting the rules in their favor, diluting the power of Black and Brown voters, and making fair representation harder to defend. But make no mistake: Democrats still have a path to retake the House in November — and EMILYs List women are leading the way. | = We have the biggest House map in the country, with Democratic pro-choice women running in the races that will decide the majority. From must-hold frontline districts to key flip opportunities, our candidates are fighting for the seats we need to take back power and put a check on Republican extremism. Today's decision does not change the stakes. It clarifies them. If Republicans are going to use every lever of power to protect their majority, then we need to respond with the full force of our grassroots movement — by investing early, organizing everywhere, and making sure EMILYs List women have what they need to win. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = The path to the House majority is still open. Derek,
This is Dan Freeman, the DNC’s Litigation Director. I’m reaching out to give you an update on the Supreme Court’s decision in _Louisiana v. Callais_. I wish I had better news.
Yesterday, the Supreme Court gutted the core requirement of the Voting Rights Act that protected majority-minority districts. This will make it _much_ harder to bring discrimination claims against redistricting maps.
The Court ignored standards set by Congress, overturned **decades** of precedent, and severely undercut a core victory of the Civil Rights Movement. With this ruling, the Court has opened the door to diluting Black, Latino, AANHPI, and Native American representation across the country, especially in the South, where Republicans have made clear they want to eliminate the voting power of minority communities.
**Derek, here’s the deal: When President Trump and his administration refuse to defend Americans’ voting rights, or actively attempt to violate them, the Democratic National Committee is ready, willing, and able to stand up and defend the American people.**
The DNC is taking on Republicans on all fronts—in the courts, in the press, on social media, and on the ground—to ensure that we elect Democrats who will stand up to these aspiring authoritarians. **This setback only strengthens our resolve to fight.**
[**If this work matters to you, please make a $7 contribution to the DNC today to help us continue bringing the fight to Trump and his allies. Before this month ends, I wanted to say thank you.
This has been one of the strongest fundraising months our campaign has had so far, and I really hope you know I don't take that lightly.
Every time a donation comes through, I think about the person behind it. Someone with bills, groceries, rent, and a gas tank that somehow gets more expensive every time we blink. Someone living through Donald Trump's economy and still choosing to give what they can because they believe this campaign is worth it.
That really means everything to me. I know people are donating for the same reason I'm running: we know we can do better.
Better than healthcare bills that can wreck a family for the crime of needing care. Better than rents climbing faster than wages because private equity decided homes should be profit machines. Better than politicians who talk about peace while our country keeps manufacturing weapons that kill innocent people and sending young people to fight wars that make the rich richer.
So seriously: thank you. For every donation, every share, every message, every little way you've helped build this campaign.
[If you haven't donated yet and you're able to before midnight, I'd be so grateful if you chipped in to help us close out the month strong.](https://cefuo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cgSH809-foEaES6wWLupiv_jr8ZRIotEemWGT4Weq6jdvak-P5coL65yq1QS8G0MVAXRm2eIDIa8B1dt-pEjh7Mc-gggK-2TleMtYxnGN4-PJM7ee_ZFRGHHTnmD3EA1h_N-R1zghqqnSO4enPHkhzok_fWlfnOIWmWo-F1zSsVJwutowYAWu0AGgIYrR0ZDg8ps7XEZfCNUzzKpMMr5f65bBMeC7aYctSpHV03_vN2a5NVIMHRutA==&c=nU-qvUkUqwSqddIAUQlYtuihFzfMjylA9ONdqwZyRarGrWxWV3U8Hg==&ch=b22S5atfEW-NJchVSQqNDejeKiJDnn0kBho4EXW2cKIA9lJS9kxh9Q==)

If you’re fired up after reading what she has to say, please chip in here to help hit our grassroots goal for April by tonight's deadline.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130489264/617935204/-1389256643?refcode=emm_ff_20260430_T1_SYAEOMLiftNote_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMTIzODdlYy1jMzQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aaqT9HhpVgTgvuKZclIkwQhkl_DE1X0OOciT7yBEfJg=)** In solidarity, The Fair Fight Team **\-----------Forwarded Message-----------**
**From** : Stacey Abrams
**Subject** : You can help power a timely, targeted model of outreach and voter protection for the midterm elections and beyond This is a moment to channel outrage into action. And that is exactly how the Fair Fight team continues to defend democracy against the rise of autocracy. I founded Fair Fight to advance voting rights after the 2018 election because, after seeing widespread voter difficulties in that year’s elections, I wasn’t willing to sit back. I knew we needed a new organization laser-focused on ensuring that every eligible voter can register to vote, cast their ballot, and have it counted. _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2163%2E259176%2EJBoeda) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2163%2E259176%2EJBoeda)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11520?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.04.30_Walz-Better-Path_B3_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON-N-T1&t=4&akid=2163%2E259176%2EJBoeda) Peter, Over the past few months, I’ve spent a lot of time listening, reflecting, and thinking about what this moment demands of us. What I keep coming back to is this: people are looking for leadership that shows up, tells the truth, and is willing to fight for what matters. I’ve run in tough places. I’ve won in tough places. And I still believe the path forward is the same as it’s always been: go where the fight is, say what you believe, and make the case everywhere. **That’s why I’m launching Small Town PAC.** I believe small towns still matter. subject: Demi is exactly the kind of leader we deserve

body:
Demi Palecek was arrested last week for standing by her convictions. That’s the difference between asleep-at-the-wheel Democrats and our progressive candidates.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260430-1&t=1&akid=3424%2E587540%2EEaGT-J)
Peter,
A lot of politicians talk a big game.
They talk about sacrifice. They talk about their values. They make never ending campaign promises.
But there’s a big difference between politicians who will tweet into the ether and call it leadership -- and the ones who actually believe in something, and are willing to stand ten toes down for their convictions, even at great personal risk.
**Demi Palecek is the latter.**
She stood in the Capitol last week, alongside 65 other veterans and military families, honoring the Iranian and American lives that have been lost to this senseless war. And she was arrested for it.
That’s the state of the country we’re living in right now. Veterans are being zip tied in our nation’s capital for peacefully protesting an unauthorized war.
And the only real answer -- the one that gives me hope -- is electing leaders who refuse to be intimidated by any of it.
**That’s what Leaders We Deserve exists to do. To end the revolving door of Democrats who play it safe and hope for the best, and to back bold progressives who actually have skin in the game. The ones who show up, even when it costs them something.**
But leaders like Demi don’t win on conviction alone. They need real resources to fight back against opponents with unlimited corporate cash behind them. That’s where you come in, Peter.
**[Will you pitch in $5 today to help us reach our $50,000 end-of-month fundraising goal and continue backing leaders who are worth fighting for?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260430_1_demi.pyQz8S&refcode=em20260430-3424&amount=5&t=2&akid=3424%2E587540%2EEaGT-J)**
With your support, Leaders We Deserve was able to back Demi and she won, despite having over **$1 million in corporate money spent against her.** She ran a campaign that didn’t just say she would fight back against Trump once elected, she did so while campaigning.
When ICE showed up to terrorize her community, she mobilized her campaign volunteers to drive the children of immigrants in her district to school so they could still learn without fear of their parents being targeted by ICE. She even helped feed her neighbors when they were terrified of being profiled by ICE at the grocery store.
**That’s exactly the type of Democrat we need more of. Someone who fights back with more than a strongly worded letter. And electing people like Demi is exactly why Leaders We Deserve exists.**
Your support today is critical -- we have a lot of elections still on the horizon, and more endorsements coming your way.
**[We have until tonight at midnight to hit our end-of-month fundraising goal. This is the moment I’m asking you to step up. Will you pitch in $5 to help Leaders We Deserve hit our goal?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260430_1_demi.pyQz8S&refcode=em20260430-3424&amount=5&t=3&akid=3424%2E587540%2EEaGT-J)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

# [This deadline matters](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=195912967&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk1OTEyOTY3LCJpYXQiOjE3Nzc1NzYxNDQsImV4cCI6MTc4MDE2ODE0NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.KCp5Zy1STo4UD6WRgfw498Fb1ZNkKMXcBaK2bxv_WZg)
### Why this deadline at midnight is so important
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Apr 30
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..iCTmOnxfQDiOPgKkesZ6DC65c_ytJ6rktBlryH5mtwM?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/this-deadline-matters?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Look, I know "End of Month Deadline" is not exactly the most exciting phrase in politics.
Nobody is out there saying, _" This is thrilling! Someone should make a movie about campaign finance reporting!"_
But I wanted to take a minute and explain why this moment matters so much - especially because we're now just hours away from this deadline, and the stakes in this race could not be higher.
Here's the big picture:
**At midnight, we close the books on another major fundraising period, and our numbers become part of the public story of this campaign.**
That means everyone in politics is watching.
The media is watching.
Republican megadonors are watching.
Donald Trump is watching.
And in a battleground race like ours - [a race that could be the most expensive and competitive Senate race in history](https://substack.com/redirect/a78679d6-50dc-466b-9d74-828caaa50067?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - those numbers send a clear message.
They tell people whether this campaign has real momentum. They tell people whether the Senate might flip. And they tell MAGA Republicans trying to buy this seat whether they're up against something real.
That's why this deadline matters. It's not just a date on a calendar. It's not just a spreadsheet. It's not just an insider number for campaign people to talk about.
It's a public test of strength. And in our race in Michigan, that means a lot.
**[Because the MAGA billionaires backing Mike Rogers see Michigan as a path to power.](https://substack.com/redirect/a78679d6-50dc-466b-9d74-828caaa50067?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
**I see Michigan as home.**
I see workers and families and retirees and young people trying to build a life here. That's what this campaign is about for me.
And I think Michiganders are hearing that. Poll after poll has shown that I'm the strongest and only Democrat able to win this race. That's big.
But before the midnight deadline, we have to show we have the resources to go the distance and fight all the way to Election Day.
That means showing the power of working people coming together to say: _I want to be part of this._
That matters to me more than I can say. **Because I 'm not doing this to impress pundits or win some cable-news segment or go viral. I'm doing this because I love Michigan, and I believe this state deserves a fighter in the Senate.**
But I can't do it without you. If you've been thinking about chipping in, I'd be deeply grateful if you did before midnight. Even $10 or $20 help us show the strength of this people-powered campaign at a really important moment.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/a78679d6-50dc-466b-9d74-828caaa50067?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you for being in this with me.
With gratitude,

Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/a78679d6-50dc-466b-9d74-828caaa50067?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Now it's being used to seize voter records in Democratic strongholds.

A counterterrorism agency is now MAGA's election police. Hi Peter, Michele here.
I'm NOT in this for the fame.
I'm NOT in this for fortune.
I'm NOT in this to spend the rest of my life in politics.
I left behind my sports career and announced my campaign for Senate because I was sick and tired of watching my state become a laughing stock. The fraud. The taxes. The scandals. The corruption. The political system that covers for itself.

[Something had to be done. Someone had to step up. And I wasn’t going to wait for someone else to get into the game – so I threw my name into the mix. ](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/oTyMeUIT-yCemQSt2g3KM7z766G1vscCovyWxkkCuM7lAZ56BXA8Fc5qlgMEUUe_AtVPY23L-jkeDVLQoXJMxvdSmzYK4JWoF8prh02bMQQbQKbX7JxaTHYOsLc5b0RV1oyM3R46tJ-D24ZdWPpM4x_yd3h42yVPprnlw9s-71ROgJpRcaZFtCtJCJ45S5CKTRDM3rUYnXhuTh6c0DFxPNbB14PU9_avce9BlySNbDniZsNS_vOcFrm6QU6O1ZBilncSRg9TuYsUR065t5pwmVQEtj9nlF3pczIH8WzamtY65OODVOEAAUw2xO6S2LNLMcLIsaupVppYhLMfA9sMhc27oTbCSwcjFDNMqfxlNH5qBQwSYlc3ylVZPzECEJb6uwi7aUxpd-_3DeOAlOA_81YC9iazTdkNMiiKUpJEyDyeIhzJ0KT_H85td_Tg426QlOKUkniDFU6DKsFoEAYDuOh4njSoXf7MQh7-XQN6zsDWMpNn3Hd8q1zquL1-GvDFNPEKmi04AeHrm5AiikQxq5prUGsSMc6a1xMXvbpaO1rGcBXY-1jN-FA0dJHzDjnu8qs-KnrR0fky4fjsT4nwtM6z0zfi6RLREcfq_PJWXyh0ny1VpYolXaIztKUZChhghA5WK6f9ExQHgka2oJKTcs1sNlAxSTuJTx_jHEe1czS5Slzon44FeCSUfa_KHQhUTwzkRTpbquOAFceLCmIjbrbIVBwETbuA16_Vfpl2KEprZxls_ZJvVbBR3Z-9F22yLAKZTvqTYQIGCmGdujAqXGySeyUvg_BrOGzQ3ReVwfN4/DA2PHyTE1GBmnkvOouDVyKvFqCGM7Vh6/20)
It's been an adjustment being in the belly of the beast.
I'm away from home a lot (like back in the day), I've honed my stump speech, and I've learned how critical money is to campaigns.
Running against an entire political system is expensive.
I'm spreading my message on the airwaves. I'm driving across the state to talk with voters. And I'm printing yard signs to boost my name ID.
All that costs money - and the far-Left has a LOT of it.
My radical opponent raised 2+ million bucks to destroy my campaign and lock this seat down for the far-Left.

clean_body: And I’m NOT in this to spend the rest of my life in politics. | Hi Peter, Michele here. I'm NOT in this for the fame. I'm NOT in this for fortune. I'm NOT in this to spend the rest of my life in politics. I left behind my sports career and announced my campaign for Senate because I was sick and tired of watching my state become a laughing stock. The fraud. The taxes. The scandals. The corruption. The political system that covers for itself. It's been an adjustment being in the belly of the beast. I'm away from home a lot (like back in the day), I've honed my stump speech, and I've learned how critical money is to campaigns. Running against an entire political system is expensive. I'm spreading my message on the airwaves. I'm driving across the state to talk with voters. And I'm printing yard signs to boost my name ID. All that costs money - and the far-Left has a LOT of it. My radical opponent raised 2+ million bucks to destroy my campaign and lock this seat down for the far-Left. Unfortunately, that's exactly what will happen if this email fails. | | | | | | | | Look: I know these emails can get repetitive but I promise you I won't forget the good folks out there who gave what they could - whether it was a big check, a few bucks, or even just prayers. All of it helps. I mean that from the bottom of my heart. Thanks for hearing me out. Be brave. Do good.- Michele Michele TafoyaRepublican for Senate, Minnesota I'll cut to the chase because I'll never be one of those career politicians who are asking you for money when they don't urgently need it.Minnesota will be ground zero in the next election.The evidence of fraud here is inexcusable, despicable, and rampant.We have a direct path to victory, but it'll be close. ---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey friends,
We’re excited to announce our next [Freedom Festival](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) speaker:
**👉 Greg Gutfeld — Live on the Main Stage (Saturday)**
_Host of GUTFELD! (the #1 show in late night) & Co-host of The Five_
If you’ve watched Greg, you know he doesn’t fit the mold.
Outrageous. Outspoken. And unapologetically honest. A political satirist and humorist, he’s built one of the largest audiences in media by
doing something most people won’t—taking on the narrative, calling out hypocrisy,
and saying what others are thinking but won’t say out loud.
He’s even been called “the most dangerous man on television.” **And now, he’s coming to Colorado.**
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
And he’s not coming alone. 👉 Nick Shirley—independent journalist known for exposing fraud and reporting from the ground—will headline the Mountain Majesty Gala (Saturday night).
At RMV, that’s the same mission we’re on in Colorado—exposing the truth, asking
the REAL questions, and bringing forward the stories others won’t.
Nick Shirley does it on the ground. Greg does it on national television.
Together, they represent exactly the kind of voices we’re bringing to Freedom
Festival. **[Get your tickets here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** And join our [priority list](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the next speaker drop.
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Plus, keep your eyes peeled for a Tina Peters update/deep-dive video coming later today.

This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, April 30, 2026.
– Team RMV
|

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[The $3M campaign behind Colorado’s CoCo rail tax proposal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The Colorado Department of Transportation had options when describing what $3 million in state transportation funds would buy. Public education. A feasibility study. Community engagement.
It called it a Ballot Access Plan.
That language — “develop a Ballot Access Plan and Implementation of the Plan” — sits in the purpose clause of a contract which took effect on March 26, 2026 between CDOT and the Front Range Passenger Rail District, the latter established by the legislature in 2021 to plan and eventually build passenger rail along the I-25 corridor. RMV obtained the contract through a public records request.

**[Judge Barrett denies Tina Peters bond, calls future appeals “frivolous”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Judge denies bond, keeps Tina Peters in custody:** Judge Matthew Barrett rejected Peters’ request for release pending appeal, ruling he could not conclude she was unlikely to flee and keeping her in prison as her legal team prepares an appeal.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130497228/617949111/-1080350292?sourceid=1058608&refcode=WUEFEPa11_20260430_WhitmerEOMRS_PL&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNWU0MzBmYS1jYTQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=36siaNpjVxef2a7XlKFu5XQmg9GCyvxOzFKLSFr_J8M=) Hi Peter,

It's Gretchen Whitmer.

I know we're all concerned with the chaos coming out of Washington, DC. We're seeing health care and basic necessities being ripped away from the people who need it most and dangerous attempts to roll back our fundamental freedoms.

That's why Democrats have a clear to-do list. We need to get organized, we need to get energized, and we need to show up for the people who rely on us to make a real difference in their lives.

We're seeing health care and basic necessities being ripped away from the people who need it most and dangerous attempts to roll back our fundamental freedoms. That's why Democrats have a clear to-do list. We need to get organized, we need to get energized, and we need to show up for the people who rely on us to make a real difference in their lives. And the great news is — when we do that, we win. We've seen powerful Democratic victories already in 2025 and 2026, proving that voters are still ready to stand up for reproductive freedom and support leaders who fight for our fundamental rights. It's time to take care of business, Peter, which, in Democratic politics, means one thing — it's time to look to EMILYs List. My friends at EMILYs List have been helping Democratic pro-choice women win elections for 40 years and counting. Their role in changing the face of power in American politics can't be overstated, and I'm proud to be an EMILYs List woman myself.= | = Here's what I know for sure: More freedom is better than less. Hi there!

You’re getting a lot of emails from us about our end-of-month fundraising goal. We know these can be a lot, **but we hope you’ll keep reading about what Sue has done from her Providence City Council seat — and what she’d fight for as LG.**

|
* Carbon neutrality ordinance for all municipal buildings by 2040 — first Climate Jobs City in the country: clean energy with strong labor standards built in

* Utility accountability: Requirements so the utilities can’t tear up our roads and sidewalks without proper notification & repair

* Committed us to Vision Zero and prioritized street safety and access — including the North Main Street Task Force

* Tenant protections and rent stabilization advocacy

* **The LG office is a place where people can bring real problems and get real help — on affordability, housing, climate, and more**

---

And this is just some of the vision Sue brings to the entire state of Rhode Island. It’s a lofty effort, but one that Sue can pull off with all of us working together.

Our end-of-month deadline is in just a few hours, and we’re still short 39 donors to help meet our goal of 250 grassroots supporters. **[We’re hoping you’ll help us make OUR vision (talking to every voter in the state) about SUE’S vision for Rhode Island a reality.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqucTtwdhB9JCqTOmaNtHEtX5ckIe-whHGk8guMRd9mEklmfuG41l9OI-Ch-DuJMkwAbUuoUBEfZW7D2DOKN5tnY8-QEq13nbMGbvpAzvF2MTdYRFIgoE250PJNwlJ5OEb2zGiA2A5GkSxlT_ynW-k4cxTLlurGmXQs32puQG2cuJNaMMIic-ixIE4EKUPoyRdTeCbDkNIhmbw0ue7oIuqJvkIbSWqvbYF0oS4gt__oYuOtMkmAa4WdK_EfcUr70RZ9CR25sDo29jGpQBZmlYsIj2MsUy_apTNCiJNVTk_6esP4xcBIj4nY_suvcnf4IkZtREONScvOg8VdF-TBwpqrgOEn3VhbaIUULVtVyzpUR9i4LGZyL9mZVCA9dqiVTk7wccNUichndg8nr6Zxp338_9npvn7skCYqC9SnNnfRypQ/4q8/HB9bQ73ZSG-cTe3_MN4sDw/h0/h001.d7Ru5G5r5h3FEShHb1aQ_5-SRyWIy3AI7k-Dmvoewa0)**

| | **Please note, we have decided to cancel the Monday morning rally in Olympia. Instead, we are going to celebrate once Kshama is officially on the ballot, and spend next week building for the**[**May 9th Fund Healthcare, Not War Town Hall**](https://kshamasawant.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ef0e21448b54140a81773aff&id=43591e0897&e=bbdb764b3a)**!**
---
| | Dear Peter,**On this Saturday, May 2nd, the Kshama for Congress campaign will be canvassing all over Washington State’s Ninth Congressional District!** We’re getting very close to Monday, May 4th, when Kshama will officially file to get on the ballot. JOIN US FOR OUR FINAL WEEKEND PUSH!We already have more than enough signatures to get Kshama listed on the primary election ballot. **Thanks so much to everyone who contributed your time and effort to collect THOUSANDS of signatures!** But we are not stopping, and we will be going strong this coming weekend because, the more we can get, the stronger our campaign becomes. All this signature-gathering represents the tens of thousands of conversations we’ve had with working people at our tables. And what working people are saying is that they want someone who will go to war for**them, NOT the billionaires.** No Congressional candidate in Washington has collected signatures to get on the ballot in many years. **Kshama and our campaign are different. In all her elections to the Seattle City Council, Kshama always got on the ballot by submitting signatures from working people in her district.****Collecting signatures has given us the opportunity to speak directly to thousands of people in the district and get them directly involved.** Some of those people are longtime supporters, but many of them are hearing for the first time about Kshama, **the independent socialist who won the nation’s highest minimum wage, the Amazon Tax, many landmark renters' rights laws, Seattle’s Indigenous Peoples’ Day, free abortion, and so much more**. We’ve had two incredibly successful Volunteer Days so far, and now is an opportunity to flex the muscles of this base of support we’ve built over the past few months! If you haven’t volunteered with the campaign yet, this weekend is going to be one of the best opportunities to! If you have before but haven't been out in a while, come help us talk to hundreds more working people to let them know about the most important campaign in the country and the need to support Kshama with signatures, donations, and volunteering!Unlike past Volunteer Days, we’re going to be meeting up at many different locations instead of starting all together in one spot. Campaign organizers will be at every location to help lead training, give answers to common questions, and take a group picture! Snacks and water will be provided as well!We’ll talk to people about how Kshama will take the same movement-based, fighting approach in Congress as she did in Seattle, and about the demands of our campaign:
* Free healthcare for all — Tax the rich!
* End all military aid to Israel! End the occupation of Palestine — No weapons or tech for genocide or imperialist war!
* Stop the deportations — Shut down ICE & the detention centers!
* National rent control — Build millions of affordable homes!

---
| | Kshama's opponent, 29-year incumbent Democratic Congressman Adam Smith, is a general of the war industry. Smith voted for the over $906 billion war budget for Trump just in December last year! This is directly funding the horrific war on Iran. Smith has voted to send tens of billions of dollars for the genocide in Gaza. He voted to create ICE and has repeatedly voted to fund it.Smith has been richly rewarded over the years by AIPAC, by weapons manufacturers, and by companies profiting from the deployment of ICE agents, like Palantir. He continues to be bankrolled by them and billionaires like Alexander Karp.Adam Smith and the Democratic Party are deeply fearful of the mass anger against the wars and of Kshama as Smith’s opponent. Kshama and her fellow revolutionary socialists have shown again and again that they can win historic victories for the working class. That’s why **Smith is now busy trying to launder his blood-drenched track record**. Let’s not let him do that! Let’s deal a serious blow to the forces of war and the deportation engine by taking Smith down and replacing him with the first-ever revolutionary socialist in the U.S. Congress. **What Smith will never have is an army of working-class volunteers! Kshama Sawant led thousands of working people to defeat big business in Seattle throughout her decade on the Seattle City Council! Let's defeat them again — see you Saturday at 11:00 AM!** Solidarity,Kshama for Congress

name: Adam Schiff
subject: I’m forcing a vote on the Iran War. Here’s why
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
|
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9771%2E5257348%2EG8KAdJ)
Derek, I’m forcing a vote in the U.S. Senate to end the war in Iran. From day one, I’ve called out this illegal war. I’ve demanded the Trump Administration seek congressional approval. And I’ve fought to make Trump officials testify under oath to try to defend this war of choice. But to no one’s surprise, Trump has ignored the rule of law and continued to wage an expensive, dangerous war with an unpredictable opponent. It’s cost American servicemembers their lives. It’s cost you more at the gas pump. And it will cost our country for years to come. Trump’s increasing frustration makes him even more unpredictable and dangerous. He threatened, on social media no less, that "a whole civilization will die tonight." clean_body: This is the last deadline before the May 5th Primary. We cannot fall short now. | Peter, As we move through April 2026 , the stakes for our country have never been higher. We are well into President Trump’s second term, and House Republicans are working around the clock to deliver on the America First promises that voters demanded. From securing our borders to slashing the red tape that stifles Michigan’s entrepreneurs, we are finally restoring common sense to Washington. But the job is far from over. The Democrats and their radical allies are already pouring millions into Michigan to stall our momentum. They want to obstruct our agenda and take back control of the House in the upcoming midterms so they can return to the failed policies of the past. I am fighting every day to protect your freedoms, grow our economy, and rebuild Michigan into a powerhouse of opportunity. But I need you in this fight with me. | By standing with Team Walberg, you are defending the values that define our state: hard work, fiscal responsibility, and a commitment to the next generation. We have a historic opportunity to enact the full MAGA agenda, but it requires a strong Republican majority that won’t back down. Every seat is a battlefield, and the fight for the future of our country starts right here in Michigan. Thank you for your continued support and for standing for our values. Tim Walberg MEET TIM Tim Walberg believes in the Michigan values of hard work, entrepreneurship, compassion, and creating opportunities for each person to use their God-given gifts to care for their families, reach for their dreams, and help their community. As an elected official, community foundation leader, manager in higher education, and pastor, Tim has demonstrated a consistent commitment to advancing opportunities for individuals to succeed and doing his part in elected office to help make America a pillar of freedom and hope in the world. Of all of Tim's accomplishments, he is most proud of his family. Tim and his wife Sue have been married for 50 years. They live in Tipton where they raised their three now-adult children Matthew, Heidi, and Caleb. [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/10234?t=8&akid=1242%2E124072%2EnUo801)
Peter, it’s Roy.
**[With our crucial end-of-month deadline quickly approaching, I’m personally asking you to chip in $5 or any amount now to help us reach our $500,000 goal. Can I count on you?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/10245?amount=5&t=9&akid=1242%2E124072%2EnUo801)**
| | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/10245?amount=5&t=10&akid=1242%2E124072%2EnUo801)
---
I’m a North Carolinian through and through. I’ve spent my life trying to do right by the state and people I love, and I’m grateful for this opportunity for another chance to serve.
Our grassroots campaign is growing stronger every day. This race has been rated the only Toss-Up currently held by a Republican by experts at Inside Elections – and now, the GOP and right-wing groups are promising to pour tens of millions into this race to defeat me. **That money is having an impact: A recent poll shows this race statistically tied.**
That’s why it’s so important that we hit our fundraising goal. Right now, we need those resources to fight back – and I’m not relying on billionaires and special interests. I’m depending on folks like you.
**[Please, Peter, will you chip in $5 to power our campaign to flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/10245?amount=5&t=11&akid=1242%2E124072%2EnUo801)**

Thank you,

Roy Cooper
| |

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8188?t=2&akid=1242%2E124072%2EnUo801)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.
