| | Peter, Yesterday, the Supreme Court handed down a ruling that made one thing crystal clear: the courts cannot fix gerrymandering. Congress has to. For decades, politicians in both parties have rigged the system by drawing district maps designed to pick their voters before a single ballot is cast. The result is a Congress full of incumbents who don't answer to you — they answer to the map. Yesterday's ruling in _Louisiana v. Callais_ is just the latest proof that this problem isn't going away on its own. Courts bounce cases back and forth. Maps get redrawn and re-challenged. And while the lawyers fight, real communities lose real representation. **So today, I'm making a commitment.** If you send me to Congress, **I will fight to ban gerrymandering — full stop**. Not just partisan gerrymandering. Not just racial gerrymandering. All of it. Congressional districts should be drawn by independent commissions, using neutral criteria, with one goal: making sure voters choose their representatives — not the other way around. The 2030 Census triggers the next redistricting cycle. That is the deadline. That is when the next decade of maps gets locked in. Congress has to act before that window closes, and I will be pushing from day one. I've spent my career fighting for Lowcountry communities that don't always have a seat at the table — as a Coast Guard law enforcement officer defending our ports, as a municipal attorney working on housing, flooding, and infrastructure for Mount Pleasant and Hilton Head Island. Gerrymandering is what keeps those communities from ever getting that seat. This campaign is different. We don't take corporate PAC money or outside special interest money. We don't have out-of-state tech billionaires propping us up. Redwoods drink up the fog that drifts from the ocean into the redwood forests. Snowpack in the Sierras doesn’t just form a beautiful blanket for the Giant Sequoias; it’s a crucial source of moisture for the massive trees. These giants are also important stewards of water for entire ecosystems. A healthy redwood forest helps filter the water that rushes through creeks and streams. When their branches fall into streams, they create structure for juvenile fish to grow big and strong. The shade the big trees provide keeps the waters cool too, providing a comfortable home for a variety of aquatic life.

clean_body: Cast your vote by May 6th! | | | | | | Dear Peter, Voting is open for our 2027 calendar cover photo! The relationship between redwoods and water is special and fascinating. Redwoods drink up the fog that drifts from the ocean into the redwood forests. Snowpack in the Sierras doesn’t just form a beautiful blanket for the Giant Sequoias; it’s a crucial source of moisture for the massive trees. These giants are also important stewards of water for entire ecosystems. A healthy redwood forest helps filter the water that rushes through creeks and streams. When their branches fall into streams, they create structure for juvenile fish to grow big and strong. The shade the big trees provide keeps the waters cool too, providing a comfortable home for a variety of aquatic life. | | | Kern River Nicholas J Klein / Shutterstock Klamath River Virrage Images / Shutterstock | | Rough-Skinned Newt David Herasimtschuk Sonoma Coast Redwoods Justin Lewis | | | | | From the Grove of the Titans to the coast of Big Sur, water breathes life into these trees, and we need your help choosing the cover photo that best showcases this dynamic relationship. Peter,
As a single mom, Katie Porter understands the challenges Californians are facing every day. She knows what it’s like to balance a budget and stretch every dollar.
That’s why Katie is running for Governor with a bold plan to tackle California’s affordability crisis head-on.
**As Governor, Katie will fight for:**
🩺 Single-payer healthcare
🏡 Less expensive housing
🍼 Free child care for all
🧑🎓 Zero tuition charges at the University of California and California State University
💰 Eliminating California income tax for those earning less than $100,000
Katie has a _real plan_ to make California more affordable — and she’s ready to fight for it. But she’s up against opponents who think they can buy this race.
Her opponent, Tom Steyer, has already poured a staggering $147 million of his own money into his campaign, while other candidates are being propped up by Big Oil and corporate interests.
Katie can’t self-fund her campaign with a massive check. And she’s refusing all corporate PAC money because Californians deserve a Governor who answers to them, not special interests.

Fellow Patriot,

I want to tell you something about my parents.

My dad was a high school math teacher. My mom taught elementary school. They weren't famous. They weren't wealthy. But they showed up every single day for their students, their community, and their family.

They taught me three things that have never left me: work hard, keep your faith, and serve others.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=beeb0d2c8e934a32b42403fb9bb672b5&_e=nEgjqS-sgq2WpSc-ke5DJ1n-HDqMsYDQa_yTzfxXHJ1KIsc7fb5rG3SX0ImEY4R6y1dc1oj8zKU4PyNIeYBHLu8Vame9nXuiwNGxmxhAzUtrfWblrxRdWbcfpbzOKm7Vm-F6r_WsTX2xtLRt8EJ5r0KnoekX733ZQyAaPnff6VXUeQpDZ4xgE-MCwOFHIKPPf5qQ2ftcfytKNV8LN8pPBjYngf9Zq2HzxE_1Z29W3MTLp2XcexorfGro0WA3QXBejCqC0ti_AdJCBGqIHFzYbZOStTVj8JIVWiTKDeLlOIe65S5KLxSOvp0Ndk2BPVxp5Z0MeaqaBYoUM4FCfUoCHyWuPLv-mYoT2Bqvyi-V--bz8O8ctsO84dOFOvEj6nI1KKK4JUzCZ3zYSrYo8yj9F42wzuMb0yf5g0t-R7SNo4hMKDXfZrizCklBjUfyZ3ZaMey67QqvNPmFwfUBHY8MbVeSTMrHDiX9LzVYGf0rqP5OtH1mcbvUkF7Kc4LaHzX59_6W4_3jUT5rLfq_6A5TwbLMNJBOSKjQ-d1ih68i7pAnUEVBuceNbCfQdmzz3t3I11zkl-ydGqs-lZPat6zioLtvV3AF4n17onwVXEwXoPcfqZB0DFuyDJPiwNGJQaaateMuPs0zLMMy2eKsx9kOafJbIGUdQje-yK3fXNdEpOosQm6LJysJ4bwTe3ZVZDZA)
I've carried those lessons through every chapter of my life.

From high school in Miles City, through college in Colorado and the halls of Harvard Law School, to my decades of public service here in Montana.

As Director of the Montana Department of Revenue, I worked to cut taxes and keep more money in Montanans' pockets. As U.S. Attorney, twice nominated by President Trump, I went after the violent criminals, cartels, and drug traffickers that were destroying Montana families.

And off the clock, Sandra and I gave our time to the Boys and Girls Club, St. John’s Lutheran Ministries and St. Vincent’s Healthcare, among many other nonprofits because service isn't something you clock out of.

That's who I am. That's how I was raised.

And that is exactly why I'm running for United States Senate.

clean_body: Two teachers from Great Falls shaped everything I've done since. | Fellow Patriot, I want to tell you something about my parents. My dad was a high school math teacher. My mom taught elementary school. They weren't famous. They weren't wealthy. But they showed up every single day for their students, their community, and their family. They taught me three things that have never left me: work hard, keep your faith, and serve others. I've carried those lessons through every chapter of my life. From high school in Miles City, through college in Colorado and the halls of Harvard Law School, to my decades of public service here in Montana. As Director of the Montana Department of Revenue, I worked to cut taxes and keep more money in Montanans' pockets. As U.S. Attorney, twice nominated by President Trump, I went after the violent criminals, cartels, and drug traffickers that were destroying Montana families. And off the clock, Sandra and I gave our time to the Boys and Girls Club, St. John’s Lutheran Ministries and St. Vincent’s Healthcare, among many other nonprofits because service isn't something you clock out of. That's who I am. That's how I was raised. And that is exactly why I'm running for United States Senate. Will you help me get there? Thank you for your time, and for considering being part of our team. subject: A lot left to register and not much time
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Here's the deal, team: Voter registration work happens all year long, not just in the summer and through the lead-in to the deadlines ahead of Election Day.
There's no better way to defend our fundamental right to vote than by registering a ton of new voters and winning critical local, state, and federal elections. Our access to the ballot -- from vote-by-mail to drop boxes to early voting and more -- depends on being able to pass laws that are pro-voter, not pro-incumbent politician.
As little as $3 supports our work to register a new voter. Please, RUSH $30 or more right now to help us register 10 new voters to fight back at the polls >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=043026_3&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
MS NOW: ‘The largest investment ever’: DNC launches voter registration drive [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=043026_3&amount=30]
The 2025 elections showed us a valuable truth, folks: Voter participation is increasing in all the right ways.
Voter registration activity increased across the country. According to the team at National Voter Registration Day, New York recorded more registrations for their 2025 events than in 2024, and California saw similar increases. Earlier this fall it looked like voter participation was going to make a real jump, even in a so-called "off-year".
Then Election Day came. New Jersey had more voters turn out for a gubernatorial election than they had in 20 years. Crucial counties in Pennsylvania saw their highest turnout levels in almost 15 years. New York City reached a turnout percentage unseen in over five decades.
We can drive even higher levels of participation when voters understand the stakes and feel like their vote matters , just like it did last November. That's why our voter registration efforts are so important, and why we work on it all year long.
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you step up with $30 or more today to help register 10 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=043026_3&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=043026_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=043026_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=043026_3&amount=50]

The key is getting young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights across the country -- to see the importance of voting now more than ever. Pundits in Virginia said they could have called the election results when they saw the first turnout numbers from the major college campus locations around the state. That's the kind of impact these young voters can have.
Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The upcoming midterm election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.
New voter registration -- at a cost to us of just about $3 per new voter -- can be game-changing. Can you pitch in with $30 or however much you can to help us register a tidal wave of new voters ahead of this year's voter registration deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=043026_3&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. She learned her work ethic and tenacity from growing up in a union household and honed her skills of problem-solving and collaborating over six years in the Maryland State Senate. name: Lizzie Fletcher
subject: The Voting Rights Act & SCOTUS
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
The Voting Rights Act is one of the most important civil rights laws in the history of the United States: the result of a generations-long struggle to ensure the right to full participation in our democratic society for all American citizens and a triumph over a long and shameful history of racial discrimination in voting.
Yesterday, the United States Supreme Court gutted Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act , which has served until now as the last legal barrier against overt and intentional racial discrimination in American politics, and betrayed generations of Americans past and present who fought for the right to vote and for full citizenship for all Americans.
If the Supreme Court will not protect the right of all Americans to participate in our democratic process, Congress and citizens must. Every one of us can—and must—do the work to protect the progress the Voting Rights Act represents and the promise of American democracy for all.
We must all be active participants in the work to organize, litigate, and mobilize, as the Congressional Black Caucus has explained, until the promise of this democracy is not just defended, but fully realized for everyone. That means organizing, advocating, and building the coalitions that will defend our democracy. That means marching, door-knocking, calling, and showing up everywhere to fight for our fellow Americans.
That’s the work we do together on this campaign. In this moment, we should remember the words of Congressman John Lewis, who came to Houston to campaign for this seat back in 2018 and who told us all:
Never Give Up.
Never Give In.
Keep the Faith.
And Keep Your Eyes on the Prize.
When we come together, organize, and stay focused, we honor those who worked to ensure the promise of our democracy for all, and we continue their fight until victory is won.
Together we can do anything,
Lizzie Signature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]

**Peter, time is running out before our April fundraising deadline - and we need your help to make sure Carmela hits our $13,500 goal.**[**Will you rush a donation right now to help us get there?**](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=2bf78664e5&e=a7b299e420)

Next week is filing week, and we’re just over 3 months out from Primary election day.

What we do _right now_ will determine whether Eastern Washington gets the representation we deserve - or another 2 years of a rubber stamp for the MAGA crowd and corporate donors.

You already know what’s at stake: rising insurance premiums, militarized federal agents terrorizing our communities, lost agricultural markets, rural hospitals shuttering, and chaos in trade and energy prices.

Carmela’s running to stop that - to fight for us, our families, and our neighbors - to protect healthcare and public education, restore stability for farmers and workers, lower prices, and defend equal rights under the law.

**But to get there, we need to meet** _**every**_**fundraising deadline between now and November.**

[**So, Peter - will you pitch in now to help Carmela hit our April goal and keep Eastern Washington moving forward?**](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=57dd0f9928&e=a7b299e420)

Peter, The race for Texas Attorney General comes down to a simple question: _what is the office for?_ Over the last decade, AG Ken Paxton has used the authority of the office to pursue his political ambitions, to serve right-wing partisan interests, to intimidate and persecute and interfere. In so doing he has undermined public trust in the office itself. The role of the Attorney General is to uphold the law, and ensure that power wherever it accrues and accumulates – is held in check. That includes making sure that markets are competitive, not manipulated. It includes protecting people from abuse, not enabling it. And it includes rooting out corruption, not participating in it. The framers of the Texas Constitution understood something important: power must be checked. That’s why this office exists. Restoring public trust requires running the AG’s office the way it was intended to be run: independently, lawfully, and in service of the people.

clean_body: OAG should serve the people of Texas, not special interests To unsubscribe, | | Peter, The race for Texas Attorney General comes down to a simple question: what is the office for? Over the last decade, AG Ken Paxton has used the authority of the office to pursue his political ambitions, to serve right-wing partisan interests, to intimidate and persecute and interfere. In so doing he has undermined public trust in the office itself. The role of the Attorney General is to uphold the law, and ensure that power wherever it accrues and accumulates – is held in check. That includes making sure that markets are competitive, not manipulated. It includes protecting people from abuse, not enabling it. And it includes rooting out corruption, not participating in it. The framers of the Texas Constitution understood something important: power must be checked. That’s why this office exists. body:
| I need to apologize to you.
I'm sorry, truly I am.
I'm sorry that some people accuse you of not being MAGA if you don't make a donation.
I'm sorry that some people lie to you about who they are to try to trick you into donating.
And I'm sorry that many folks don't even show their appreciation when you do donate.
It drives me crazy that people try to treat you like that, and it's important to hear why I do things differently.
First things first.
This is Majority Leader Steve Scalise.
Secondly, I want to thank you for all of the support you've given to the GOP over the years; it really means a lot.
But right now we're staring down some concerning numbers, and it has my team and I really worried.
The Democrats are currently unloading 100 million dollars into 35 GOP seats to obliterate our House Majority once and for all, and here is the truth: Right now, we simply don't have the funds to fully fund our campaign operations in all 35 races.
[So the simple truth is that I need your help before our House Majority is a thing of the past.](http://links.right-red.com/u/click?_t=7f2cc7f35be547959fee68a54bdac0d9&_m=dba1308696c545e7abed1ad6383d6ef6&_e=VdYvlbbObxzhbixdyNTAjPsJb-iT27DZiKIwSZUkT4_GjDk47rC8l5icg2bERfxdvx-z9XNEoqu012P-FPMo73ZcracqnXFPQfTKKR_vT3khzY8ftlWbAM7QwYOSsNVmaSM0arGQJNyZVIHRF_evORIt-JmF3LkQesyMsKh1mkQF65NNfcf7WLh_oART9rkkCYJzTGx6bxyYj-IQlaJHVAZWqtlcczLxp5xfUgssGHFnN6mLBpRn4ISgaXXAUJlI6_SmR0J2e0v8tvPMo8SbCFcsZ45R6etRhMJlPsSEMtNilorQoouz8yNm_IjoiMBZsdZnGWGyxfSprSN3Ix0239NbT3zELpaE7XpDd7Q5zPjeyoZ9T8-kAGstNkSLFrerDH3GGWzg31DMCDuTfLeEnS03O2O3BqtIaNiXYcx4Yj-s7xa2HXUzC5TKrMIp1EXjO-TNhOJEnBxpASHdHLjMwmw84GcjcBi6CALPD5EitWnEYAIF9zKfRiFRJQaoESyAL8ZbLzLGTRT5PoCre7vajJiMfBxyCqC-qp-cmLl0rSbgdhi2yxiuuiV8nJ46GmK5dvOtXH4MlD6AlLcfuWMxVlk7OYBkuYA0_wJNXj1uR6oHRvYmAbT7WTWOsy7iSM5gVX417GXwjsGX71Bn3smrXQnBP4hmmJKslAnjsiEmn-TBOAQK6iBHYykgiZSwfRx5)
If you can't afford to help right now, no problem. I won't hold that against you. Taking care of your loved ones always comes first. I will never question your Party loyalty or shame you for not making a donation.

|

Friends — quick note before I sign off for the night (and I hope you’re enjoying some time this evening, too).

Our team has spent the week emailing you about what it takes to travel our great state to talk to voters in all 39 municipalities.

We’ve also spent the time asking you to help keep our supplies stocked, hire summer interns, and stay fully caffeinated on our long rides crisscrossing the state.

I was there on January 6th.
I was at the Capitol -- surrounded by sweat, screams, blood, and chaos -- doing my job. Protecting the men and women sent to Washington to govern our nation. It didn't matter if they were Republican, Democrat, or Independent. My duty was to protect them. My duty was to protect our democracy.
Donald Trump sat and watched for hours. **He did nothing -- and people died because of it.**
When it was over, I thought the hardest part was behind me. I was wrong. The death threats came. The harassment came. The pressure to stay quiet, to move on, to let it go -- it came from everywhere.
But I made a decision:**I wasn 't going to stay quiet.**
I testified in front of Congress because it was my duty -- not just as an officer, but as an American. I stepped forward to protect this democracy when it needed protecting. And I've never looked back.
I'm ready to take that same fight to Congress, but I need your help to get there.
#### **[We're staring down our end-of-month fundraising deadline, and we need to hit $500,000 in just a few hours to show the country this campaign has the grassroots support to win. Will you chip in before the deadline hits?](https://substack.com/redirect/c45195ba-62a9-495a-937f-b229079190b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[JOIN THE FIGHT](https://substack.com/redirect/c45195ba-62a9-495a-937f-b229079190b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I've never been motivated by politics for politics' sake.
I'm running because someone has to stand up to the lies, the hate, and the bigotry that brought us to January 6th. Someone has to make sure we never see a day like that again.
That's what this campaign is about. That's what every dollar you give is going toward.
#### **[If you've been waiting for the right moment to get behind this campaign, this is it. Rush whatever you can before tonight's deadline, and together, we can bring some sanity back to Congress:](https://substack.com/redirect/c45195ba-62a9-495a-937f-b229079190b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Together in the fight,
Harry

It’s us against fascism in a fight to organize, mobilize, and keep me fighting in Congress. I cannot do this without you. [**_Will you please chip in $27 today to help hit our April goal so we can keep our movement strong? >>_**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/F3oxcj6sbKyu8bI5PduoSA~~/AAPPABA~/qm5fVdSKuNfd4fPEW9ojydXcmBQwobZIiKJDNFZ9SS69tsTxgrKKky08Q2IlBM-UVpC2Kwrnx6u3hWqkX7jmc8kZxF7KEFOOqdnQQE21yS_XGMp68EZyr907sq6BDd8aZWMKTSm4G_Xi2k4elwY8KBeLPKWJewQduRyM1b0KSaaIoe5V05fA2f2kkdYeNtkd_EDFTvR0gbV65Nv-zVoio0fndeBVafH8V-oC59XIKtb7TIddzvWOUXRlB6KyetPZfw5ucskOG5lZjqqHnJKP5pjDb6XSnCEfwg-6Z1yFSdOtHKEX2M5ysotp2vTcQtfvlew1b4Hp75CGZ3WFHiXwGheRcTgID1jgBSAWyEJvUfQ~) Listen, Peter. Hi team,
Dan Meuser just lost it.
A reporter told him that Americans are frustrated that the House was planning to leave for a 10-day break without passing a bill to pay TSA workers.
**Dan said** _**" talk to the f***ing Democrats!"**_**and stormed off.**
Dan's job is to represent us in Congress and get things done. But how are you supposed to work with the other side - or even negotiate - if this is how you talk? That's not how I was raised.
[CHIP IN BEFORE MIDNIGHT](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9131ff4f-7c7a-46ca-b2de-783f48c60faa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Dan also said that when Congress goes home, "we have conference calls, we do other things, and we work for our constituents."
What work? The last time Dan told us about the "work" he did in our district, it was a fancy fundraiser and [events that weren't even in our district.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/fb04c873-0084-4c4b-82b0-0563a71a6c06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **He doesn 't do the job in Washington, and he sure doesn't do it here.**
He can run from that reporter, but he can't run from us. We're going to hold him and his potty mouth accountable in November.
**[Chip in before our end-of-month deadline at midnight to help me fire Dan and give our part of PA the representation we deserve.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9131ff4f-7c7a-46ca-b2de-783f48c60faa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Team, Governor Janet Mills just stepped out of the Democratic Senate primary in Maine, making room for a new generation of leadership. That was undoubtedly a difficult decision that took real courage — something our party needs a lot more of right now. The stakes are too high to keep doing things the same way and abiding by the same playbook, allowing Trump to weaponize the federal government, ignoring families that can't afford to stay in their homes, and condoning a war with no end in sight.

_**This moment calls for leaders who understand this moment and are ready to meet it with a real plan and real urgency.**_ That's why I'm running for Senate against a long-time incumbent, who, similar to Mills, will be 86 by the end of his next term. Voters across Massachusetts are saying the same thing as voters in Maine. Friend, As lawmakers around the country consider new maps that could hand additional seats to Republicans, the Supreme Court has just weakened one of the most important protections against voting discrimination. **In a new ruling yesterday, the Court made it significantly harder to challenge maps that dilute the power of Black voters and other communities.** This is a big shift. For decades, the Voting Rights Act has been one of the main tools communities could use to fight back when district lines were drawn to weaken their voice. Now, the standard to challenge those maps is much higher, and many cases may never succeed. That means maps can be drawn to split up or pack minority communities in ways that reduce their influence, with fewer legal consequences. It also puts the burden on voters to prove intentional discrimination, which is extremely difficult to show, even when the impact is obvious. **The result is fewer protections and more room for maps that silence voters.** At Voting Rights Fund, we support candidates and leaders who are on the front lines of fights like this. clean_body: They just made gerrymandering easier. | | | Friend, As lawmakers around the country consider new maps that could hand additional seats to Republicans, the Supreme Court has just weakened one of the most important protections against voting discrimination. In a new ruling yesterday, the Court made it significantly harder to challenge maps that dilute the power of Black voters and other communities. This is a big shift. For decades, the Voting Rights Act has been one of the main tools communities could use to fight back when district lines were drawn to weaken their voice. Now, the standard to challenge those maps is much higher, and many cases may never succeed. That means maps can be drawn to split up or pack minority communities in ways that reduce their influence, with fewer legal consequences. It also puts the burden on voters to prove intentional discrimination, which is extremely difficult to show, even when the impact is obvious. The result is fewer protections and more room for maps that silence voters. At Voting Rights Fund, we support candidates and leaders who are on the front lines of fights like this. As protections are stripped away, they’re often the only thing standing between fair representation and maps that silence voters. Because once these protections are gone, they are very hard to restore. —Daniel Weiss Executive Director Voting Rights Fund | Voting Rights Fund wasn’t created just to defend voting rights — we elect the leaders who will expand and protect them. Our aim is to keep our operational costs as low as possible, so a majority of our funds go toward doing the work that needs to be done. That means building a national bench of lawmakers who will fight tooth and nail to expand access to the ballot box and protect our right to vote at every level of government. Here’s where we stand. Our goal was $92,430. As of this morning, we’re at **$83,726.** That leaves a gap of **$8,704** with less than 24 hours remaining. If we close that gap by midnight, every investigation continues at full speed. If we don’t, I have to start making cuts. **Let me tell you what’s on the line tonight.** Jonathan Choe is in San Francisco’s Tenderloin right now. He’s been there for weeks. He’s building something significant. If we don’t fund May, he comes home. Whatever he’s documented goes dark. We have two new Citizen Justice League operatives who just deployed. Their first investigations are underway. If we miss this goal, their assignments get shelved. The LA District Attorney has an open file on our Cash for Ballots evidence — 28 documented felonies. body:
Trump and his allies are trying to silence their opposition — us.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=6411%2E582294%2EyneSYK)
I wanted to write you a personal note about an alarming attack on free speech.
The FCC, which is controlled by Trump’s appointees, is _once again_ trying to attack Disney and ABC’s broadcast licenses because of a joke Jimmy Kimmel has made on his late-night show. _Read that again: The administration is openly trying to take the network off the air._
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260430_3.WlZFNT&refcode=em20260430-3&t=2&akid=6411%2E582294%2EyneSYK)
**This should raise alarm bells for everyone in this country.**
When those in power seek to silence any voices that disagree with them, it is a threat to the First Amendment freedoms we in New Hampshire and people across America hold dear. We have not seen this level of censorship since the McCarthy era.
**This is not how our democracy should work.**
I took an oath to uphold the Constitution — and that includes defending the First Amendment, which protects our rights to free speech and protest. Donald Trump and his allies cannot be allowed to bulldoze our freedoms and bully Americans into silence.
We need to act now to make sure he can’t. That means flipping the Senate, defending our rights and freedoms, and ensuring that our democracy — which only survives while we have free and vigorous debate — can live on.

This campaign is about more than politics — it’s about protecting the rights and freedoms that define who we are as Americans. **With your help we will flip the Senate and provide a crucial check on this administration’s power.**
Let’s stand together in this moment,
Chris

name: Doug Jones
subject: Disgraceful
body:
Re: The Supreme Court

| |
---
Folks, **[Because of the Supreme Court’s ruling to overturn the Voting Rights Act, Alabama will once again be ground zero in the fight for voting rights. That’s why I’m running for Governor. If that’s all you need to know, please make a split donation between Nellie Pou and me here. If not, keep reading.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130509213/617988283/1580640496?refcode=260430_dj_split_l1&ms=260430_dj_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTU0MDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWQ2NmYzMjMtZTQ0NC1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=2TmN2XsAigq8uXn93qPvsWdrsQP7bYv2cHv_dXrahcU=)** I’m disappointed and angry—but not surprised—by the Supreme Court’s recent decision. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130509214/617988284/1417368197?refcode=260430_dj_split_img&ms=260430_dj_split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTU0MDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWQ2NmYzMjMtZTQ0NC1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=2TmN2XsAigq8uXn93qPvsWdrsQP7bYv2cHv_dXrahcU=) Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act protected Black representation in the South for decades. It was a pillar of our country’s march toward progress, and our democracy. It’s why we saw the late Rep. John Lewis and other Civil Rights heroes get beaten on the Edmund Pettus bridge in Selma. It was the product of generations of freedom fighters. Justice Kagan said it better than I can: _“The Voting Rights Act is—or, now more accurately, was—‘one of the most consequential, efficacious, and amply justified exercises of federal legislative power in our Nation’s history,’” _ _ “It was born of the literal blood of Union soldiers and civil rights marchers. It ushered in awe-inspiring change, bringing this Nation closer to fulfilling the ideals of democracy and racial equality. And it has been repeatedly, and overwhelmingly, reauthorized by the people’s representatives in Congress. Only they have the right to say it is no longer needed—not the Members of this Court.”_ Now, state governments will become even more critical in the fight to protect our right to vote. But we’re not going quietly. _And there is still another path forward._ [**Your support today can help protect fair representation, fair maps, and fair elections despite the devastating new ruling in _Louisiana v. Callais._ Please rush a donation before tonight’s midnight monthly grassroots fundraising deadline as we work to defend our democracy.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130509460/617989290/-1934436445?refcode=emm_ffa_20260430_T1_EOM4Callais_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTQ0NjVmNy1lNDQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j-we24k9SKbesyKv-tqAUUW49F7KoDvykeExoJ5t3Ks=) **Here’s what the Court has done, and how it opens the door to rigged maps and one-party rule:**
* Dismantled the Voting Rights Act’s key safeguard against racially discriminatory voting maps — reducing Section 2 to a shell of itself
* Given politicians a green light to draw new maps where Black and brown voters can no longer elect their preferred candidates
* Set the stage for potentially creating 19 more Republican U.S. House seats and eliminating 191 state legislative seats, the vast majority held by Black elected officials

Take it from dissenting Supreme Court Justice Elena Kagan, who explained how now, **“a State can, without legal consequence, systematically dilute minority citizens’ voting power.”** **Justice Kagan called the ruling the “latest chapter in the majority’s now-completed demolition of the Voting Rights Act”** — a law that “was born of the literal blood of Union soldiers and civil rights marchers”, “bringing this Nation closer to fulfilling the ideals of democracy and racial equality.” **But here is how the pro-democracy movement is fighting back:**
* Organizing and pushing state and federal lawmakers to protect fair representation, ensure equal access to the ballot box, and reform the extremist Court
* Pushing blue states to counter discriminatory redistricting by redrawing their maps
* Building mass resistance now and mass turnout in November’s midterm elections
* Ensuring that discriminatory maps will be challenged

We will keep fighting until every one of us has an equal voice in our democracy — **because we refuse to accept a future where politicians choose their voters instead of voters choosing them. ** [**If you’re outraged about this ruling, and if you’re able to help fight back with a donation today, chip in to support the fight for free and fair elections.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130509467/617989297/-1934436445?refcode=emm_ffa_20260430_T1_EOM4Callais_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTQ0NjVmNy1lNDQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j-we24k9SKbesyKv-tqAUUW49F7KoDvykeExoJ5t3Ks=) _If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_ | [Chip in $5](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130509470/617989304/718574001?amount=5&express_lane=true&refcode=emm_ffa_20260430_T1_EOM4Callais_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTQ0NjVmNy1lNDQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j-we24k9SKbesyKv-tqAUUW49F7KoDvykeExoJ5t3Ks=) | [Chip in $25](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130509472/617989307/718574001?amount=25&express_lane=true&refcode=emm_ffa_20260430_T1_EOM4Callais_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTQ0NjVmNy1lNDQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j-we24k9SKbesyKv-tqAUUW49F7KoDvykeExoJ5t3Ks=)

name: Christopher Ahuja for Congress
subject: Ahead of the midnight deadline - Real talk for District 32
body:
We deserve better

| | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=d39332e580&e=53c7d12fc7)
| | | | | | Peter,
I’m writing at the end of a long month — one that’s made something clear.
**We are being led by people stuck in the past while the stakes in our lives keep rising.**
**In Washington, leaders move quickly to fund wars overseas, but drag their feet on what people here actually need** — affordable housing, stability, dignity. In our District, families are being priced out and pushed to the edge, yet somehow there is always money for conflict and never the same urgency for us.
**That’s not leadership.**
**For decades, Brad Sherman has gone along with that status quo** — supporting endless war funding while our district struggles. That approach asks you to believe nothing can change.
**I don’t buy it.**
We need forward-looking leadership that meets this moment head-on. **That means fighting to abolish ICE** and protect our communities.**It means being ready to impeach Donald Trump on day one** if he continues to abuse power. It means choosing our communities over endless wars abroad.
This campaign is about building something different — rooted in people, not corporate money.
[**We’re up against our end-of-month deadline tonight. If you’re ready for real change in Los Angeles, chip in $25, $50, or whatever you can reasonably share.**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=e55c832242&e=53c7d12fc7)

# **Mac-and-cheese thief busted after stealing $80K from Chick-fil-a**
A former Chick-fil-A employee in Grapevine, Texas, has been arrested for allegedly stealing roughly **[$80,000 in a surprisingly simple but effective mac-and-cheese scam.](https://substack.com/redirect/89a640fd-e9fa-4021-9033-088b6280d35a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/89a640fd-e9fa-4021-9033-088b6280d35a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Keyshun Jones was fired** from the restaurant last November, but authorities say he didn't stay gone. Instead, he allegedly snuck back into the store repeatedly, rang up hundreds of orders of mac and cheese on the register, and then issued refunds straight to his own credit card.
* **Police say he managed to** pull this off roughly 800 times before the restaurant noticed the suspicious pattern of phony refunds.
* **He was finally taken into** custody on April 17 by the Texas Attorney General's Fugitive Task Force and Fort Worth police. He now faces charges of property theft, money laundering, and evading arrest.
* **If convicted,** he could be looking at up to ten years in state prison -- where, ironically, he'll still be able to order mac and cheese, just under much less pleasant circumstances.

[Barlow Logo](https://barlowforwyo.com/)

Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, inf=
ormation and upcoming events.

=E2=80=8A

SUPPORT GROWING, WORK CONTINUING

Hi friends,
=C2=A0
Support for our campaign continues to grow across Wyoming, and I could not =
be more humbled by it. The signs, photos, messages and encouragement mean a=
great deal to Kelly and me. Keep those sign photos coming.
=C2=A0
Your contributions help keep us on the road, reaching more communities and =
moving this campaign forward. Thank you for all you are doing and if you or=
someone you know is in a position to give, we welcome the support.=C2=A0
=C2=A0
Last week, I was in Cheyenne for the State Emergency Response Commission me=
eting. Kelly also joined me in Laramie for UW=E2=80=99s College of Business=
75th Recognition Dinner, the Spring Football Game and the Laramie River Re=
ndezvous. The world needs more Cowboys, and Wyoming is turning out some of =
the best.
=C2=A0
We were also honored to receive support from my former legislative colleagu=
e Scott Clem and the Associated General Contractors of Wyoming. Their backi=
ng means a great deal as more Wyomingites look for a thoughtful Wyoming con=
servative.
=C2=A0
Kelly and I also attended the State GOP Convention in Douglas. Thank you to=
everyone who stopped by, visited with us, learned more about my record and=
helped work the Barlow booth.
=C2=A0
There has been discussion about the state GOP endorsing candidates before t=
he primary. I respect the role of the party and the people who give their t=
ime to it. But contested primaries should belong to the voters. A stronger =
party and a stronger Wyoming come from respecting that process and coming t=
ogether once voters have made their choice.
=C2=A0
Thank you for your continued support and for helping us keep riding for Wyo=
ming.

Stay strong. Stay Wyoming.

[SUPPORT ERIC!](https://secure.winred.com/eric-barlow-32097f9d/donate?sc=3D=
winred-directory&money_bomb=3Dfalse&recurring=3Dfalse)

Endorsement - The Associated General Contractors of Wyoming

Wyoming is built by people who show up and do the work. That's why I'm hono=
red to have the support of the Associated General Contractors (AGC) of Wyom=
ing and the men and women who help build this state every day.

=C2=A0
Wyoming's future depends on building a state where opportunity is broad and=
the workforce is strong.

=C2=A0
That means respecting skilled labor, supporting workforce training and appr=
enticeship, and recognizing that
Wyoming needs all kinds of builders across trades, businesses, communities,=
and career paths.

State GOP Convention
We enjoyed the opportunity to stop by the State GOP Convention last week an=
d visiting with delegates and folks from across Wyoming.
=C2=A0
Thank you to all the delegates who were there doing the important work of t=
he party, reviewing bylaws and resolutions.=C2=A0
=C2=A0
Thanks to the alternates and members of the public showing up and being pre=
sent as well.
=C2=A0
We appreciate everyone who stopped by our booth and took time to visit, exp=
ress their support, or grab a sign or bumper sticker.

IN THE NEWS=C2=A0
=C2=A0
[Scott Clem: Who I Like So Far In The Upcoming Republican Primary](https://=
cowboystatedaily.com/2026/04/23/scott-clem-who-i-like-so-far-in-the-upcomin=
g-republican-primary/?fbclid=3DIwY2xjawRbZfZleHRuA2FlbQIxMQBzcnRjBmFwcF9pZB=
AyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEe5a61XteZCY9Jsp7u8Bsu4p3XH2Oy_080DY8DaOBGHrhaIQj6k=
1hA-NrgI2g_aem_gsacl56-Wb_fURPiWZooqw)
=C2=A0
"Some criticize Eric for not being =E2=80=9Cconservative enough=E2=80=9D or=
for voting against certain bills. But I=E2=80=99ve watched him approach le=
gislation with care and integrity. He doesn=E2=80=99t rubber=E2=80=91stamp =
poorly written bills just because they carry the right label. He reads the =
text. He considers the consequences. He weighs the impact on people and on =
the state. Supporting an issue doesn=E2=80=99t mean every bill claiming to =
advance that issue is good policy. Eric understands that distinction, and h=
e votes accordingly. =C2=A0
That=E2=80=99s not weakness. That=E2=80=99s wisdom. And it=E2=80=99s exactl=
y the kind of judgment a governor needs."
=C2=A0

On The Trail

CASPER
Kelly and I had a great night at a locally hosted fundraiser in Casper.

=C2=A0
Over 100 people showed up, all engaged and ready to talk about Wyoming's fu=
ture, from energy to healthcare to economic development. An exciting night =
full of real conversations and ideas. Thank you to Beth Worthen for organiz=
ing the event.

LARAMIE
Great night at the University of Wyoming College of Business Awards Dinner =
with Kelly. Always good to hear from people invested in Wyoming's future.

=C2=A0
It was great catching up with Sen. Gary Crum and his son, former University=
of Wyoming Cowboys football standout and current Denver Broncos offensive =
lineman Frank Crum.

I also appreciated spending time with College of Business Advisory Board me=
mbers=C2=A0Dershie Barber, Tim Barnes, and Ashley Harpstreith.

It was also great catching up with Renny MacKay, President of the Wyoming B=
usiness Alliance; Sena Krula, Outreach and Engagement Coordinator for the U=
niversity of Wyoming College of Business; and Quique Girones, MBA Program D=
irector for the University of Wyoming College of Business.

Congratulations to Owen Fink for being the student awardee.

LARAMIE
Kelly and I loved cheering on all of the Wyoming athletes at the UW Footbal=
l Spring game and the Laramie River Rendezvous Rodeo!=C2=A0

| Hi, folks,

The AI lobby has officially entered our race — and they’re preparing to spend whatever it takes to defeat us. In a moment, **[I’m going to ask you to donate to our campaign](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu9GgNqQBZQbHGys41Ff66GbQ7omrOFvOr9SBpsg46qa8cyVSHCJU4ZczjGn526_8r8Vw4Ji7bNerQ1t62FQMrBstZHdOnGsvZQvIqEg1NJYEXG2b5mJ_rz3cxf0zCDZE6HmhgkgXJIOycce-3JHU8vD2vOsUeb-lF5zLHWHfqhbvrjZU5NcxM7MdA1H3FXIr1lmfYfVFptm8OLgD0EgrUKGWT1vipVzCK80CVulC-OSqmaEsHMwTp3RnjKRcfur9F8sb348NO0zuTj9LoPJDmAKbG_OMZoaQgWrGebvkpwRYaOQXVgW-Rmg22dzwxf5LU16IQGGz8kq2HqNIcFWDNfv_ug3m7-74sG3z--rZHcaEL5Mtl6ENxs1VUQDf5DRoE/4q8/mtpIiZiWRXSegY6JtuOV3g/h0/h001.m4LaWp-EwrmZDtJxQuULOi4JlGhwPFrAlv3hDKPH6Lc)** , but before I do, I wanted to unpack why this moment matters so much.

My opponent, Scott Wiener, will say he “regulated AI.” What he won’t tell you is what happened behind the scenes — after meetings with industry lobbyists, that bill was watered down to the point where it’s practically meaningless: reducing potential fines from $10M to $1M, and dramatically reducing whistleblower protections.

It’s a win-win for him and for them: he gets to claim he acted, and they get to keep doing whatever they want.

And now, they’re rewarding him with major super PAC spending in our race:

[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu9GgNqQBZQbHGys41Ff66GbQ7omrOFvOr9SBpsg46qa8cyVSHCJU4ZczjGn526_8oh35l8Dau3L3IBE_D9yNMStHslNhb6EbYAr8O3Sd8Uv8kHBnFOnc4Wfa-3LaIp3Jbxppuk-UfIE2YZhIn1cXbMbqY9LiZvH4WhPx-r7SbTE4kXATIlTMtR1qxfAKhiWHo5WPwPmtSg1Poula1U4oWD3oadTej32k5Tdgfzc9DlFc7sTeh9y-x07MFnnuovkuuE3yt-1b6rV1x0eGpIaQBq89FDaRXcn4bW5ojBn1nxkSmDeIKfcDo50QCmsNIS7GHNkxCLU8f96IcrRMLrtB_aBiH2Q33lY3iTCRJJgGjiYdfcvcJNxTz72CpQjEIJCQU/4q8/mtpIiZiWRXSegY6JtuOV3g/h1/h001.k0NyZGsw5ZlS1G3XXhHkHwUD-dI88o1gUsqj3rSmB9M)
This is exactly how our political system has been corrupted — legalized bribery, dressed up as policymaking.

But this fight is about something much bigger than one bill or one race. It’s about the kind of future we’re building.

Right now, we are standing at a crossroads between two very different worlds:

A Mad Max dystopia, where a handful of powerful corporations use technology to consolidate wealth, control information, and leave everyone else scrambling just to survive.

Or a Star Trek future, where technology helps us eliminate scarcity, expand opportunity, and give everyone the freedom to live a meaningful life.

But this latter vision won’t happen with slap-on-the-wrist regulations. It will happen if we can, as a people, control our own destinies. If we can control where this technology goes and how it shapes our society. We should not let a handful of CEOs decide our future for us.

This choice is not abstract. It’s being decided now, and that’s why I wanted to share the SuperPAC attacks coming for us.

The AI companies know they can’t control me. When I go to Congress, they’re not going to get empty regulation — they’re going to face real rules, real enforcement, and real accountability.

The AI lobby can spend millions, but we have something a lot stronger: people power.

Grassroots movements have beaten the corporate establishment before — and we can do it again.

**[So if you’re ready to fight for a future where technology serves all of us — not just the powerful — I’m asking you to sign up to chip in $1 ahead of the primary June on 2nd.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu9GgNqQBZQbHGys41Ff66GbQ7omrOFvOr9SBpsg46qa8cyVSHCJU4ZczjGn526_8qBIMRzqPVWa1s6U_6kehuBGIuLW5EzPtNYhOuQJgoSCNZ2FPEkfgNxdKbPvA7BKOzRzp6bcxslXlFvL5xwDKCWxG_j0S76J6YgZX152rNLOzRu55NOeSVLiBjoGusyonfzjY83Jnm0sjkKQmAs39m8B0vSIls8D7hrbwwiqlK7r8HhwI4vHGsps3CF6M05xdTjQdrfQapYgwAvcpoWKi-huQuHG6s1p5jadfqbO2MzG5Lo9hyxr3RuwxJI2TqPGvmyWdukcwVxY_mqKJ7J3C7ODZ8fSlCJaziUq_bC7VwhJtuTjvzoS-wqwSTmqIaUZZo/4q8/mtpIiZiWRXSegY6JtuOV3g/h2/h001.AUY7QuZ5pP31Mh_VQgMCLhxuye-Tg1iIBywXyT36D5E)** [Donate »](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu9GgNqQBZQbHGys41Ff66GbQ7omrOFvOr9SBpsg46qa8cyVSHCJU4ZczjGn526_8ptGHLYYHAhojzV8FyYCinWw-9lV7cAPQr8vPfZzcIC2vGHzHOzTD6l7iIugp9QkcYuIsXZvucIhV5dj5b4LiRWN_qqoMHWNlsD5rY0Zp4Th_oeHdzbTnnKLaz9iQFmzcBB5gOw1CA0HH_ZGJRcD_MmOXTxv0DpHW9bem1prZz4wxkwOxpqYwfME38X_TU98jR-Lrkh09q1F_K_QY59Saw3FKdUKtl1_L21QOwxmb0RuJHO1TNyQEI8nN2W9hTQs4agX_2rUlqEYPvtjx4XhWR7q2pUnu71_cBKJyqTkDsddnVtHj9uUY5IkxsoRfmXafM/4q8/mtpIiZiWRXSegY6JtuOV3g/h3/h001.OSIbU315T8mEMDX2gEE8JpvyH_JtZ69CwGNpmoP0oL8) We can win this.

Peter, I need to be honest with you about how I'm feeling right now.
I'm angry. I'm heartbroken. And I'm more determined than ever.
The Supreme Court just gutted the Voting Rights Act -- a law that civil rights activists fought, bled, and died for. A law that finally gave Black Americans in the South the power to make our voices heard at the ballot box.
And now MAGA extremists have destroyed it.
If that wasn't enough, Speaker Mike Johnson just backed Governor Landry's plan to "postpone" our elections.
---

This isn't about logistics. This isn't about administrative convenience.
Make absolutely no mistake about it: This is about diluting the political power of Black people.
They gutted the Voting Rights Act so they could do exactly this -- rig the system, suppress the vote, and hold onto power by any means necessary.
But one thing about me: I'm not going to sit back and take this idly.
I'm a third-generation farmer. Hard work, tenacity, and toughness are in my blood. I've spent my life fighting for what's right, and I'm not about to stop now.
But here's the truth: we also need to be focused on hitting our end-of-April goals. That deadline comes up in just a few hours.
Yes, it's been a week of devastating news. The Voting Rights Act gutted. Elections postponed. Our democracy under assault.
But we still have the golden ticket to get us out of this: the chance to FLIP this Senate seat.
When we win in November, we don't just elect Louisiana's first Black Senator since Reconstruction. We send a message that voter suppression will not stand. That democracy matters. That Black voices will be heard whether MAGA likes it or not.
But I need your help. We have just a few hours left before our end-of-month deadline, and we need to show strength right now -- not weakness.

If that wasn't enough, Speaker Mike Johnson just backed Governor Landry's plan to "postpone" our elections. | == This isn't about logistics. This isn't about administrative convenience. Make absolutely no mistake about it: This is about diluting the political power of Black people. They gutted the Voting Rights Act so they could do exactly this -- rig the system, suppress the vote, and hold onto power by any means necessary. But one thing about me: I'm not going to sit back and take this idly. I'm a third-generation farmer. Hard work, tenacity, and toughness are in my blood. I've spent my life fighting for what's right, and I'm not about to stop now. But here's the truth: we also need to be focused on hitting our end-of-April goals. But we still have the golden ticket to get us out of this: the chance to FLIP this Senate seat. When we win in November, we don't just elect Louisiana's first Black Senator since Reconstruction. We send a message that voter suppression will not stand. That democracy matters. That Black voices will be heard whether MAGA likes it or not. But I need your help. BIG NEWS: We just endorsed a new slate of candidates for 2026!
As you know, control of Congress will come down to a handful of districts. Some are already rated Toss-Up by the Cook Political Report. Others are rated Likely Republican today, but have the ingredients to become real fights if Democrats invest early: strong candidates and nightmare GOP opponents.
Meet our first round of endorsees:
* Christina Bohannan in Iowa’s 1st District – Cook rates this race a Toss-Up, and for good reason. Christina lost by just 799 votes last cycle after a recount, and now she’s back, outraising Republican Mariannette Miller-Meeks, and running in one of the clearest pickup opportunities on the map. We supported Christina in 2024, and now we’ll be with her as she finishes the fight in 2026!

* Rebecca Cooke in Wisconsin’s 3rd District – Another Cook Toss-Up and GOTV PAC alumnus. Rebecca came within 3 points of defeating Derrick Van Orden in 2024, and this time she has a head start and one of the best fundraising reports among Red-to-Blue challengers.

* Jamie Ager in North Carolina’s 11th District – This race is rated Likely Republican, but Jamie is a fourth-generation farmer with deep roots in the district, and he’s already showing real strength. You may have seen him recently featured on CNN! He won his primary decisively and has outraised Republican Chuck Edwards (who, as of today, is currently under investigation by the House Ethics Committee)!

* Katy Padilla Stout in Texas’ 23rd District – Cook rates TX-23 Likely Republican, but after Republicans nominated Brandon Herrera, a hard-right gun influencer with serious baggage, following Tony Gonzales's resignation over a scandal involving one of his staffers. Katy is a San Antonio attorney and former teacher with the profile to make this race competitive if Democrats do not write it off too early.

* Bobby Pulido in Texas’ 15th District – Bobby is a Latin Grammy Award-winning artist and the son of a migrant farm worker running in a district Republicans badly want to hold. Cook has this race at Likely Republican, but early polling showed Bobby within 3 points of Republican Monica De La Cruz. That is a race worth testing and investing in.

* Ashley Bell in North Carolina’s 10th District – Ashley is a physician assistant and educator taking on Republican Pat Harrigan. This is a tough race, but tough races become impossible when Democrats walk away from them before voters hear from our side. In a year with a competitive Senate race likely to go to the Democrats, we believe Ashley will have the momentum to turn this race competitive.
And we’re also backing two Senate candidates who could shape the balance of power:
* Angie Craig in Minnesota – A battle-tested Democrat and GOTV PAC alum, who has won tough races in a purple district and is now running for an open Senate seat Cook rates Likely Democratic. Holding this seat is non-negotiable.

* Zach Wahls in Iowa – Cook rates this race Likely Republican, but polling has shown Zach within striking distance. If the national environment keeps moving against Republicans, this is the kind of race that could become very real, very fast.
We don’t wait until every forecaster agrees a race is winnable. We look for candidates who can expand the map, force Republicans to spend defensively, and turn close races into flipped seats with the right turnout investment. subject: I just questioned Pete Hegseth in a committee hearing

Pete Hegseth appeared in a House Armed Services Committee hearing yesterday, and we exchanged words.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]
As the proud representative of the largest military community in the country, I had *a lot* of questions for our Defense Secretary.
My office’s phones have been ringing off the hook, with call after call from military families who are concerned about the President’s mental fitness to serve as our Commander-in-Chief. So I asked Hegseth if he thought Trump was mentally stable enough to send our troops into harm’s way.
Instead of answering, he immediately pivoted to talking about former President Joe Biden. I reminded him that Biden isn’t the President (since he seemed to forget!), at which point he said he “wouldn’t even engage” with me in a conversation about our Commander-in-Chief.
And then — of course — Hegseth went on to speak over me, again and again and again.
Color me shocked that a guy who elevates the idea that women shouldn’t have the right to vote felt fine to bulldoze a woman Member of Congress questioning him in an official hearing...
Bottom line: Pete Hegseth couldn’t defend Trump’s mental fitness because he’s NOT fit to lead this country or to lead our service members into war.
We cannot let this chaotic and dangerous administration continue unchecked. Flipping the House in November is a matter of moral clarity, a matter of national security, and a matter of democratic stability.
If you’re with me, please contribute whatever you can right now to help me win re-election, flip the House in November, and keep fighting against Hegseth and the rest of this reckless administration. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]

SCOTUS Ends Race-Based Gerrymandering

The Supreme Court's conservative majority issued a [6-3 ruling Wednesday](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2uozAQhZ8GOkf-hVC42CZdtt0SmZkBRmtsZJvk9a-SR7jl0Tk6-vT9e87PwJHT9jcc5EtbZ8w4Ix0ZSmi417pfDfM7UcLayqylHoS0wsg5xVn16BEwKOjJq3Ec3aSMMv3u18naOw3S6HVaVqONAyQAlPbuFlpUz_5zJa2R2mjl1I3sNCk0ToEhHFF1VoZIpd0KndcSGUJqof5fcwG6QT766PfWztqZP51-dPoRzkTv-qk-oTSGSJ1-1OssdJCAfJUmXrlx2kThbW9VQE5boVo5pxBFIeTaCsN3EvPFlUMKIgSHIy5IIygzOLsaq1A5DTqg03rqi8fzzTFyHcbOyu0IHL-I7RdGX17_BAAA__9-9Ifv), reworking the three-part test plaintiffs must pass to win a Section 2 redistricting challenge and making it far harder for Democrats to draw seats in red states that lean left by engaging in race-based gerrymandering. The ruling voids Louisiana's court-ordered second Black-majority congressional district and [ends the requirement](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L2uozAQBeCngc7IP4BD4WIbumy7JRo8TvDG2Gg8BO3br3Kl-wK3PUc6Ovr-3Jc7xBTz8zfswRE_Fiy4YNiLJ2Dcat1OxnLlkLEyLVrqUcheGLnktKgWHXoE5dvglLV2mJRRpt0cwCphHdcJR7STXW9-tDBqsDeFMA1jG91nSvZGaqPVoLrQT5NCMyhvAlpUTS8hBeKOwnGuKXrIDPX1KORD58veJrcxH7Uxvxo9N3q-rqujcHKg-uk_SaGEjZ7PKup5UNiD8OUkFmsq_lVFKmesETKId-GYn2KHQ1yRN1GDLxnFmsC_xA5_C0X-JzBWpuhZfCvoqdFzSw6PK6YU62ibXj53iOnrIf8A9O30_wAAAP__LSqIAA) that states use race-conscious data in redistricting to protect minority voting power. Nearly 70 of the 435 congressional districts are currently shielded by Section 2, according to election law experts. Southern states are moving swiftly to call special sessions and [redraw congressional maps before the 2026 midterms](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckc2q2zAUhJ9G3inox5bihRehIaveblro0pzoHMeismSkk2v69sX3EbqagY8ZGOb3x_wBMcX8-gEbTZWXGQvOSFsJFRjX1tY3YzkyZWxcZ6OMk6qXVs05zbrDCQOCDh1N2ns_jNpq260TDIvVI1iD_RPH54LD4sArMk6R1uO1i9NZpXqrjDV60Bfqx1GjHXSwhB616BUkqnyptL-fKQbIDO3PUmqgSyhbl6aVeW_C3oR5CPM4juOytXwyYR6U5bsJ88h0nLKXFDmG0x4rsGwMTE2G8k4ouf6VXGQljI1rDCwhowREuZVK8lV22Qj4DEOVt5sx_vW8CfsoIaKw960RvjLvwrg9CHv__u3XT2Fc-PyiblxsAHTegu7DFUEPyjlzHcfFLt4_hXEUhb1r3dUJ9yOmFJvzolevDWL62sr_cc3nZP4FAAD__3SVm1U), with Republicans positioned to gain seats across the region. Democrats warned the ruling guts six decades of civil rights protections for Black voters. ★★★
DHS Shutdown Ends at Last

The House voted Thursday to pass the Senate's Department of Homeland Security (DHS) funding bill, [ending a record 75-day shutdown](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D1uhDAUBODTmM7If8BSuEjjbtOmROa9t4sVYyPbLNePNlIukHqkbzTzdV_uPsSQnp9-J1vaY8GMC9KeofiGW63b2TBfiRLWVhYl1MiF4VosKS6yQ4uAXkJHVk7TNMxSS91tFlahJNxmLcR4Q7iNhJpWQwNJAg2yC_ZNCaOF0koOsiczzxL1IEETTiiZET5SaX2h41xjAJ-ar9-PXIB6yHsX7dbaUZn-YMox5a7r6iGld8aUe-tMOWGYclow5Y4cQwtQmXK4Vf63iz_OhCE9-Rpi5Fs-K_FXbtQVi8cVYgx1nJgRz92H-Nvb_nHTy6qfAAAA__8_W3by) of the agency after Speaker Mike Johnson reversed course and brought the Senate-backed package to the floor. The bill funds DHS through September 30. The package [restores funding](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D2O5CAUBODT2BkWP7ZpAoJNnPWmG1o077lhF4PFw-2d2496pLnAxFUqlb4_9_XuYor5-dvtaGvbViiwAu7FV9cgEIWzQbkyZqBWV8nlzPjIFF9zWkUPFjw44Xu0Qms9GaGE6oP1AgQ3wkjjzDQBcI1CKs1vt3F6-Nn00b6n-Ki4VFJMYsDRGAFqEl4haBDdyF3C2oaKx_lI0bvcHP3bSvU4-LL3yYbWDurUr04unVyu6xq28j_jRe-8k8tRUmzRUyeXUE5CdjgiJEaYXUMGgdh2Zoj5yR4xJea2hpX9LSFTyaziC-u77stZCZmeGbgP9g3CqLkMZdv6auG4YkqRZt2N_Lm7mL4eth-Avqz8DAAA__-JyokQ) for the Transportation Security Administration (TSA), the Coast Guard, the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), and cybersecurity operations -- but excludes new Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) funding that conservative hardliners had demanded as their price for a deal. Johnson had [held out for weeks](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLHO3CAQhJ8Gd1jLgn_OBUUad5c2pcWxezYKBgu4-PUjR8oL_P1oZr7v13N9-phi3n76g13t75UKrcRHCdV32lvbP53KlTlT63VFwC8JRmpYc1rVQI4CeRUGdspaO81KKz3sjrUGfiCqh1ITcNDBBAVeWfPg6YV2iO6uAqMBNapJjWzmWZGeVNBMlpQw4BPXPlY-P68Ug8_dt9_vUgOPoRxDcnvvZxP6h8BF4HJd13iWFHsM5Q4IXDJfTeByLwlcwAhcNAhcQslb5dbkTSUrh1JJtt33zjXmTdLe5H9wCTADWGuH6ui8YkqxfVlhYDt8TP-e9G-I--PwbwAAAP__wOh7kQ), insisting Republicans needed to launch the party-line reconciliation process to fund ICE before clearing the broader DHS package, but relented Thursday as TSA paycheck deadlines loomed. Trump is expected to sign the bill. ★★★
ATF Drops 34 Gun Regs

Minutes after the Senate confirmed Robert Cekada as the new director of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives (ATF), the Department of Justice (DOJ) and ATF [jointly announced 34 regulatory actions](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0DuunDAUgOHVmM7IL-BSuEhDd9OmRAefA3hibOTHjLL7aGYJdwO_fn1_vtdv8MHH4zdcZHPdV0y4Il3JZah4lnK2iukVKWKpeVVCjVwYrsUawyo7tOgQpOvIymmahllqqbvTmk2OUsxf426U2cYBpi9DkzECpEEchs7bd0oYLZRWcpA9mXmWqAfpNOGEkhkBgXLtM91tC95BrFD-7ik76l26umDPWu_C9C-mFqaWRyvVO-qP9GRqSTcwtdyZqQXTg0NEDnXnEGNq0RHPdLQANeV_PNOe8lV4JmyO-NYyUiw8wIvD5tHHgx8t8jdCLp_S1oqPVAqVLlu8Xz4EX8aJGXFc4MNnr_5A82nV_wAAAP__ZUyHZQ) to roll back gun control rules affecting owners, dealers, and small firearms businesses. [Attorney General Todd Blanche](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O3CAURp8Gd4z4tYeCIo27TZvSusO9tlljGAGOk7ePdh8h9ffp6Oj8-lg-IKaYt59wkq99XbDggnSWUKHj3tp-dSx3poyt10UJNXJhuBZLTosc0GNAkGEgL6dpsk5qqYfdm9WE54vk82lxnKyD0WlnSSkj0ZlRDdF_oYTRQmklrXyQcU6itjJowgklMwIS1f6o9L5eKQbIHdqxlhroEco5JL_3_m5M_2BqZmq-oe0xb71k-gNnzFS_bkzNme7G1Px5tR4DMTUba5ywE1Mzlk_e4aDGIZ48pCsff_l2ZV5puxL0WHLj0Fdey4tq54EOQOCh5DXW83sfqsf3HVOKbZyYEdsJMX0L9v_o-durfwEAAP__F2yHHg) framed the package as eliminating "clunky" regulations that burdened law-abiding gun owners, citing a 14-month DOJ review of every Biden-era firearms rule. Second Amendment advocates called it the largest regulatory rollback in ATF history. Gun grabbers [vowed legal challenges](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL1ugzAURp8GNiP_YcLgoQtbunZE5voG3Bgb2Zfw-lU6d-r6fdLR0fm6z3cXYkjrp9vRFnrMPvvZ456hOPJbrdtJPl8Jk69UZsmlYVwzxecUZ9F668E7AS1aMQxDPwolVLtZLQZjlNEOudAj9Gq8LQ4W08ueK22gDfaN4lpxqaToRYd6HIVXvQCFfvCi0dxFLNQVPM4lBnCJXH0-cgHsIO9ttBvRURv10cipkdN1XV1aIOFV338jpyPHQAFqI6fvs1IAZB4PV2jHRH-ObM8vrKzkGNni4MnWM7GC6xkdhZwqK5Cc0vIm-7ZYf1whxlDN0Gi-7i7EXzH6R8eXlT8BAAD__1m2hLg) immediately, arguing the rollbacks will make it easier for prohibited buyers to obtain weapons by narrowing the definition of who must hold a federal firearms dealer license. The 34-item package includes both final rules and proposed rulemakings.
* * *
Florida Map Reshapes the Race

The Florida Legislature [passed the map](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD2u3SAUhFeDO674NaagSOPupU1pnXC49lEwWMCNtx85S3jdFKOZT9-vr-0LKFPZf8KZQhvvDStumM4aGww8ej8-A-tdUsE-2qaEmrkwXIut5E1OGDAiyDilIJ1z1kst9XQEtXgAsNHr2S42KrXM4EBFZ7yM4O1E4ZkSRgullbTylYz3ErWVUSd0KJkRkFMbr5auz-9MEcqA_uddW0yvWM8ph2OMqzP9g6mVqfW-79dVMw2K9SkwtZZ0d6bW54mpVZgne6bWd66NEHhOO_UM49MSbwmpj0ZxUNn5CRfH1KEM6nyvFxdi8YuxbmoBr5typj47ZsR-AuX_POMb-v4G9S8AAP__NL1-Tw) on Wednesday, creating four new GOP-leaning House seats and putting Democratic incumbents on defense. Scalise Bets on GOP Recovery

House Majority Leader Steve Scalise [pushed back Thursday](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDGP4yAQRn8N7mzBDI5DQXGNu1x7pUVmJjE6DBGQzd9fJc32W3_Se5_ev8t2CTHFfP8bDvG13zYuvLEchWrovLe2PzuXV5bMrdcNNJxGbUfUW06bGdgzcTA0iDfLsszOoMFh9-DCGa9omdAtCFpbZAdLmOcwuzPREP0bpS1qQDCzmcQ6ZxhnQyi8sFFWhyS1T1Uez2uKFHIP7f-tVJKJyjEkv_f-aAr_KFgVrJSv9B4UrG-0glVbBStqBaskoR5LHj__qeR7ldbGRiHFJuOPoo17eTaZ9n6koXp-vGJKsZ0WZfX9CDF91P0Xpb48fAcAAP__b3V2pw) on the 10-point generic ballot deficit, citing redistricting gains, incumbency advantages, and Trump's nationalization strategy. Internal GOP data showing six incumbents in serious jeopardy tells a different story.

★★★
Barack Obama Faces Hypocrisy Charges

Conservatives slammed [Barack Obama](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2OozAYAJ8GOiP_gUPh4hq6XHsl-uLPASvGtuyPcPv2q-wjbD3SaDT_7usdQgxp-wuHt5WeK2Zc0R_ZVSDcW9tPwnwln7BRXSWXE-OaKb6muIoeLToE4XpvhTFmnIUSqt-tAz6P2hktJB8nqUHijRt9g_khxYSuD_aj4lpxqaQYxeD1PAtUo3DKo0HRaQ7RVxqqL-cjBgeJoL2euTo_uHz00e5EpXXqTyeXTi7XdQ3P_D_5q314J5eSY6DgWieX_IADWA2leGTNZTob2zMxgpdn7SwlV2LvULeQArDN1_p1QEJfWV8tlivEGNpkOs23A0L8CaBf_Hpb-R0AAP__lFJ86g) for complaining about the Supreme Court's Voting Rights Act ruling one week after Obama supported a Virginia ballot initiative designed to hand Democrats control over 91 percent of the Congressional seats, even though President Trump won 46 percent of the vote in Virginia during the 2024 election.

The House voted 235-191 to reauthorize the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA) Section 702 [warrantless surveillance program](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckMHOpCAQhJ8Gbxq6YWQ4cNiLt9nrHg1DtyNZFAM4vv7GfYT_VklVqirfn9f88jHF_fPbb-xKW2bKNBNvORTfaK11PRvla-edaiszShx7qXsl5z3N0JGjQB5Cxw6MMQ8LClS3uvCkNwKMWjNbGxbFixztqKzHYBT4Lrq7SmolUSE8YGBtLZB6QFBMhkBo6ROXNhQ-zneKwe_N179LLoGHkLcuubW1owr1S-AkcLquazhyii2GfAcETil-uT8P8o2rwOleFDhJfWsrcAp5_xSut1c5tJj33kjsD18r137NZ-Veyqe10kBXHB1XTCnW0QgtP5uP6f-R9gNuX4f_AgAA__-o6XrH) for three years. The Senate now faces a choice: accept the House bill or push for a shorter 45-day extension of the unconstitutional program instead.

Speaker Johnson muscled the budget blueprint for a second reconciliation bill through the House 215-211, [overcoming Republican holdouts](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0DGO5CAQQNHT4IwWBdjGAcEmznrTDS1MlRu0GCzA09cf9Rxh4i-94P97bk8XU8yvv-4kW_uxYcEN6Sy-uo6htXB3LO9MGVuvmxRy4kJzJbacNhjQokcHfiAL8zyPCyhQQ7DOeA3iAL1IZfzkpwPm6ZBGg1uM0maI9kMJrYRUEkZ4kF4WQDWCV4QzAtPCJar9Uem69xS9y921_0epnh6-nEOyoferMfWHyZXJtQcKMaVPY3IN5aRM78bkOppxEpPh-40v6nxPN1015s4r-ZJ9TNH1WDLH0Pjh6sn3mBKT61AtXu-YUmzTzLR4nS7-8EP_xakvK78DAAD__4TueFc) demanding farm bill guarantees. The vote clears the path for Trump's tax cut and border security package.

★★★
Iran War Clock Is Ticking

The 60-day War Powers Resolution (WPR) deadline on U.S. strikes in Iran expires this week, forcing a choice Congress has avoided. No war authorization has passed either chamber, and Defense Secretary Hegseth says [operations will continue regardless](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD1uxCAQRk-DOyx-7CUUFGncbdqUFsuM1ygYrAEH5fbR5gjpPumT3pPe5329-5hifn74Ax21bYUCK-BRAvkGe6371aD0jBlqo1UJdeNi4lqsOa1yAAcBvAwDOmmMma3UUg-7sxINWo-bDGqys1YSEObwhmj0Nms7RPdCiUkLpZWc5YiTtRL0LINGMCDZJHxCaiPheT1SDD43X7-2QgHHUI4hub21szL9ztTC1NJ7H8OjZuz19TO1vCZTSySfeffEz9KRKiesJV0tlsxvgoP_4YAeUszIQ8lPwlp5o-s4mVoGcnD2mFKsN8Mm8Tx8TH_69o9a3079BgAA__8D5Hvb).

When I won my first election to Congress in 2018, we shocked a lot of people. Some pundits didn’t think _any_ Democrat could flip a seat in Kansas — especially not an LGBTQ+ Native American woman (and former MMA fighter!) who was raised by a single mom. It’s fair to say that what we did, no one had ever done before. But here’s what I always keep at the front of my mind: Winning an election isn’t the end goal. Yes, it’s a step in the process, but what really matters is what happens _after_ the election: Rallying bipartisan support for the bill you just introduced. Late nights finding ways to secure a little extra funding for the district. Answering constituents’ questions with the truth — not slick, partisan talking points. _That’s_ what folks are voting for when they fill out the little bubble next to my name. **So today, I’m asking you to invest in that kind of leadership. clean_body: I’m starting to gain some traction in the race for Minnesota Senate, and so my political opponents are starting to go negative on me. | Peter, As a former Navy SEAL , I’m used to being under attack. But the lies being told by my opponents who want to serve you in the US Senate is a new one for me. Something so sipmle that I’ve said on the campaign trail, or a position I’ve taken that my opponents may disagree with? It’s funny how an opponent can turn pretty much anything that comes out of a campaign into a flat out lie. Though I’ve been in the Minnesota Senate race for about a year now, I’m no household name by any means. But our campaign is beginning to attract the attention of voters around the state as I continue to win straw poll after straw poll (12 and counting now). Over the weekend we just won the Congressional District 3 straw poll by a wide margin! I knew I would be attacked at some point - but I naively believed it wouldn’t be so dirty or so intense. Personally, I can take the hits. I get it, my opponents see me as a threat. But here’s the deal: the Senate seat in Minnesota is too important to let petty grievances get in the way of defeating Democrats and taking back this Senate seat for the Republican Party. I know it may not be much to you, but , I can tell you that we’ll be one step closer to doubling the number of Navy SEALS who have served in the U.S. Senate. You may not know me - or even live in Minnesota, but here is what I can tell you today: I’m not running for the Senate to make contacts in D.C. that can get me a cushy job in the private sector like a lot of folks. I’m running because this country has given me every opportunity available and my service to Old Glory didn’t end when I left the military. I have a lot of fight in me, , which is why we have to send emails like this one to patriots like you. For love of country, Adam Schwarze Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate - Minnesota Former Navy SEAL officer Marine Corps Veteran Proud Minnesotan FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate Adam Schwarze is a former Navy SEAL and Marine. Chip in ahead of our end-of-month fundraising deadline →
Derek, I’m sure you’re getting a lot of emails from campaigns like this one, asking you to donate ahead of their end-of-month fundraising deadline.

I want to quickly explain why I’m personally asking you to [_**chip in to this campaign before midnight.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130513612/618000995/-2018920393?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_EOM4_260430_T1_3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MDUwMGY4MS1lYzQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TR6b_sabquA40WeByOzzue1MQNj1lljWs4H8kcb09kU=)

Look, Derek, I’ve been in public service for a long time, but I truly believe these midterm elections are some of the most important of my career. What happens in November will determine whether we flip control of Congress – or whether we spend the next two years like we have the last, with Republicans in complete control of Washington.

Right here in Virginia, we can put Democrats on the path to flipping control of Congress. But that’s only possible if we hold this Senate seat _and_ flip four battleground House districts from red to blue.

**I’m putting in the work now to win these critical races, but I need grassroots supporters like you to help me. Use this secure link to pitch in before midnight and help us reach our end-of-month fundraising goal:**

[**_https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mw-email-260427-eom?**refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com**_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/130513613/618000996/-2018920393?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_EOM4_260430_T1_3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MDUwMGY4MS1lYzQ0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TR6b_sabquA40WeByOzzue1MQNj1lljWs4H8kcb09kU=)

Mark Warner

Early in my career, Bernie Sanders gave me a piece of advice I’ve never forgotten.
He said, _“In politics, people succeed either by being really good at lying or really good at telling the truth. You strike me as someone who’s not good at lying — so your job is to get _really_ good at telling the truth.”_
So today, I’m going to tell you some truths about our campaign.
We’re statistically tied in the polls with the AIPAC-backed candidate.
We have the momentum to win.
**This is, no exaggeration, a make-or-break moment for us.**
Our primary election is in less than 100 days. We have to raise as much as we can to prove that our campaign — one that rejects AIPAC and corporate PAC money — has enough resources to take on the broken status quo and win.
Finally, one more piece of truth: **I don’t love asking people for money.**

body:
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4600%2E898137%2EU-IgN7)
When I launched this campaign, I did something Washington politicians rarely do: I told the truth.
While others stayed silent or dodged questions to protect their careers, I made it clear from day one: I will not vote for Chuck Schumer for leader.
The political establishment — the same people trying to clear the path for my opponent — didn't like that. They think Washington should pick our leaders. They think that if you play by the rules and wait for permission, you’ll succeed.
But we aren’t in normal times. We are facing a moment that requires new ideas, new energy, and leaders who aren’t afraid to ruffle feathers. Right now, the Democratic Party is facing record-low approval ratings, and frankly, it’s because voters are tired of being told, “Well, we don’t have the majority, so we can’t do anything.” We cannot keep doing the same things and expecting different results.
I’m running for the U.S. Senate to be the voice of Michigan, not the voice of the D.C. status quo. But taking on the establishment takes resources.
[**So, if you are ready for a change, I hope you’ll consider making a contribution to my campaign today before my monthly fundraising deadline tonight.**_](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/6383?t=2&akid=4600%2E898137%2EU-IgN7)

subject: This is not an optional part of the American government

body:
I’m fighting to apply the law against an egomaniacal president who wants to be King

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2881%2E4032634%2E8kzSUM)
---
As much as Trump wants to troll around and act like a monarch, he is not a king. And he will never be a king. Never. America doesn’t have them. | [](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3612?t=8&akid=2881%2E4032634%2E8kzSUM)
---
How old were we all when we learned about the three branches of government? Checks and balances? The separation of powers? These aren't just classroom ideas — and they’re not just optional parts of the American government.
This is the law. I’m fighting to apply it against an egomaniacal president who wants to be King — and I’m fighting to take back our majorities so we can put a strong check on this administration.
**[The midterms are coming, and right now is when this fight is won or lost. Can you chip in $28 or anything you can to help fight for an America that works for working people — not wannabe kings?](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3612?amount=28&t=9&akid=2881%2E4032634%2E8kzSUM)**

---
Look, this trolling is all an intentional distraction tactic. They know exactly what they’re doing. They're saying absurd things to pull our attention away from the real damage being done. It’s boring, but it's also dangerous. Trump has stripped health care from millions. He's starting wars. He's letting ICE detain children. He's driving up the cost of groceries and housing. He launched an illegal mid-decade redistricting scheme to lock in power. He’s breaking the law, and the Republicans in Congress who have the power to put a stop to this are just bending the knee to Donald Trump. They want to overwhelm us — to rig the economy, gut our government, and grind people down until they feel too exhausted to fight back. **But America was built by people who stood up to a king. We can do it again.** This team is fighting. We’ve identified 23 real pickup opportunities for Democrats to win in 2026 and donated over $400,000 from my campaign account directly to those state parties — hiring organizers, opening offices, reaching voters. I've been on the road in battleground states like Maine, mobilizing voters about these critical elections. When Trump and his billionaire allies have tried to rig the system for themselves, we have called out the corruption and proposed plans to rein them in. **None of it is possible without you, and what we do in the next six months will be critical.** Right now, a clear majority of Americans disapprove of what Trump is doing — the only president less popular than Donald Trump? Donald Trump during his first first term. The Republicans' House majority came down to fewer than 7,000 votes — that's not a mandate. This year, we have the chance to speak up and loudly reject Republicans in Congress and Trump in the midterm elections. We have the chance to ensure Democrats not only take back the House and Senate, but that we use our majorities to make aggressive, transformational changes in our country that benefit working people — even if billionaires and corporations disagree. And that’s a chance we can’t afford to waste with half-measures and nibbling around the edges. We have to be relentless in our fight and in our hope for a better future. **[Every dollar raised this month goes toward stopping the far-right and billionaire agenda that harms so many people — and toward ensuring Democrats win the midterms. So I'm asking you right now: Will you chip in $28 — or anything you can — to power this critical work?](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3612?amount=28&t=15&akid=2881%2E4032634%2E8kzSUM)** Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. #
Peter,
**There’s an all-out assault on freedom of the press happening in our country right now.**
First, GOP lawmakers worked to REMOVE federal funding from critical public media networks like PBS and NPR.
Then, the federal government used its power to ARREST journalists like Don Lemon, who were reporting on protests in Minneapolis.
